jobs.title: Associate Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Description** Artheon, a trusted leader in engineering, surveying, and planning, is seeking a skilled and motivated Associate Civil Engineer to join our team in East Brunswick**,** NJ. This position offers an opportunity to work on diverse projects in land development, infrastructure design, and municipal engineering. The ideal candidate will bring technical expertise, creativity, and a collaborative spirit to deliver high\-quality design solutions.### **Responsibilities** **Design and Drafting:** Develop civil engineering designs, including site layouts, grading, drainage, utilities, and roadways using CAD software (e.g., AutoCAD Civil 3D). **Permitting and Compliance:** Prepare and submit permit applications to local, state, and federal agencies, ensuring compliance with applicable regulations and standards. **Project Collaboration:** Work closely with project managers, surveyors, and other engineering disciplines to deliver comprehensive solutions tailored to client needs. **Technical Reports:** Create engineering reports, feasibility studies, and calculations to support project design and decision\-making.### **Qualifications** **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or a related field. **Experience:** 2–5 years of experience in civil engineering design, preferably in land development or municipal projects. **Technical Proficiency:** Proficiency in AutoCAD Civil 3D and other relevant engineering software; knowledge of stormwater management software is a plus. **Licensing:** Engineer\-in\-Training (EIT) certification required; Professional Engineer (PE) license is a plus or a willingness to obtain it. **Skills:** Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills with the ability to work effectively in a team\-oriented environment.### **Benefits** Artheon offers a competitive compensation package including: medical, prescription, dental and vision coverage, 401(k) retirement plan with employer match, educational assistance program and paid time off.### **About Artheon** Deliver transformative infrastructure solutions that strengthen communities, drive sustainable growth, and accelerate our people’s careers—to provide value added services for our clients by combining local knowledge with national expertise.

jobs.title: Database Developer
jobs.description: **About Peregrine** Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA. Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership. We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people. As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become. **People first. Ownership always.** We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation come before competence. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else. At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk. At Peregrine Advisors, you will own the queries, stored procedures, views, and logical data models for your assigned part of a federal agency's enterprise data platform. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are. This is a full\-time W\-2 position with a salary of $120,000 to $140,000 per year. It is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement is expected to be one to two days a week on site in DC. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination. **Your first project** Your first project will likely have you taking responsibility for the accuracy and performance of your assigned components. Depending on the assignment, you may: * Build Structured Query Language (SQL) queries, stored procedures, and views in Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL\-compatible). * Work across Amazon DynamoDB and Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3\). * Design logical data models and database schemas for your assigned components. * Tune queries and build S3 data loads and connectivity under governed access. You deliver database components accurate and fast enough that analysts and systems trust them. You automate the loads and checks that used to be run by hand, and you build models that keep working as the platform grows. **Requirements** * 4\+ years of database development experience * Bachelor's degree * Working expertise with Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL\-compatible), including schema design, stored procedures and functions, and indexing * Experience with Amazon DynamoDB, including data modeling and working with Global and Local Secondary Indexes (GSIs and LSIs) * Structured Query Language (SQL) across complex queries, views, stored procedures, and functions, plus relational design, normalization, and data modeling * Query and performance tuning across slow queries, indexing, and execution plans * Extract, transform, and load (ETL) and extract, load, and transform (ELT) development and data integration across Amazon Web Services (AWS) data services, including Aurora, DynamoDB, and Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3\) * Working within data security controls, including encryption, access management, and auditing * Data loading from S3 into the platform stores, plus Open Database Connectivity (ODBC) and Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) * Logical data modeling and database\-design decisions for assigned components within an established platform architecture * Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel **Preferred** * An associate\-level AWS certification, such as Developer Associate or Solutions Architect Associate * Query tuning across locking and deadlocks * Familiarity with cloud\-native application support in AWS using continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) and development, security, and operations (DevSecOps) practices * Physical\-design ownership of Aurora and DynamoDB schema and index design, or the drive to grow into it * Federal information technology or high\-volume transaction experience * Familiarity with artificial intelligence (AI)\-assisted developer tooling **Who you are** You enjoy building with SQL and take responsibility for getting data right. You can take a database problem from design through delivery and stand behind how your work performs. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task. **What you bring** * Solid SQL on a modern relational platform, Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL\-compatible), with stored procedures, functions, and views that hold up in use. * Practical skill in query tuning against slow queries, indexing, and execution plans, together with data loading, connectivity, version control, and clean delivery. * Practical experience developing logical data models and database schemas, and making database\-design decisions for assigned components within the established platform architecture. * The ability to own assigned database work from design through maintenance, working within data security controls, with sound judgment where accuracy and auditability are not optional. **When we talk** Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned. **Benefits** Medical, dental, and vision with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer\-paid life, accidental death, and short\-term and long\-term disability insurance; a 401(k) matched 100% up to 4% of salary, vesting immediately; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education. **What we offer** You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship. **What we commit to** As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better. We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply. Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. *Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.*

jobs.title: Founding Agent Harness Engineer
jobs.description: **Founding Agent Systems Engineer** =================================== Location: Onsite in Palo Alto Compensation: Competitive Salary \+ Equity **About Peano AI** **Peano AI** is building the infrastructure and application stack for the next generation of agentic AI systems. We believe future AI applications will involve many agents working together: using tools, sharing context, evaluating their own behavior, modifying systems, and improving over time. On top of our Agent Cloud infrastructure, we are building an agentic system: an application layer that can continuously optimize models, codebases, workflows, and software systems. In the near term, this means building agent systems that help codebases evolve with minimal human supervision: cleaner abstractions, stronger tests, lower technical debt, faster iteration, and better engineering velocity. Over time, we believe the same approach can extend to cloud optimization, database optimization, enterprise workflows, and more general applications. **About This Role** We are looking for a Founding Agent Systems Engineer to build the agent harnesses, evaluation systems, workflows, and feedback loops behind our product. This role is ideal for someone who is strong in Python and systems engineering, understands LLM agents and evaluation, and enjoys turning research ideas into working products. You will work on the systems that allow agents to collaborate, inspect code, make changes, run tests, measure progress, and improve over time. This is a deeply technical and product\-oriented role at the intersection of LLM agents, evaluation, developer tools, workflow automation, and applied AI systems. **What You'll Do** * Build agent harnesses for multi\-agent workflows and ralph loops. * Design evaluation environments to measure agent performance, reliability, cost, latency, and quality. * Build testing systems that connect agent behavior, code changes, and evaluation results. * Create workflows where agents can inspect code, make changes, run tests, and determine whether performance improved. * Develop shared\-memory, coordination, and task\-management systems for teams of agents. * Build infrastructure for tracking task success, regressions, cost, latency, quality, and long\-term progress. * Work on applied coding\-agent workflows, including refactoring, testing, debugging, code review, and technical\-debt reduction. * Support customer demos and applied workflows that turn agent research into usable product experiences. * Collaborate closely with ML systems engineers to make agent workloads run efficiently on Agent Cloud. * Help turn research prototypes into reliable, measurable, production\-quality systems. **Qualifications** * Strong Python engineering skills. * Experience building LLM agents, evaluation harnesses, developer tools, applied AI systems, or automation workflows. * Strong systems instincts and the ability to build reliable, debuggable tooling. * Experience with testing, benchmarking, CI, code analysis, or automated software workflows. * Ability to reason about agent behavior, failure modes, evaluation quality, and product usefulness. * Comfort working across agent logic, backend systems, infrastructure, and user\-facing product requirements. * Strong product intuition and the ability to build demos that can evolve into real products. * High ownership and the ability to operate effectively in an early\-stage startup environment. **Nice to Have** * Coding agents, eval harnesses, SWE\-bench\-style environments, or tool\-use systems. * Multi\-agent or long\-running agent workflows. * LLM observability, tracing, evals, or RL workflows. * CI/CD, automated testing, static analysis, or developer tooling. **Cultural Fit** * Hands\-on technical excellence and strong engineering judgment. * End\-to\-end ownership, from design to implementation to production outcomes. * Bias for action: ship quickly, learn from failures, and iterate. * High intensity during critical milestones, with a focus on real customer impact. * Ability to do deep, focused work and sustain execution. * Clear communication with teammates, customers, and stakeholders. * Comfort with ambiguity, rapid change, and wearing multiple hats. * Low ego, high integrity, high accountability, and strong collaboration. * Continuous learning and a belief that judgment, intelligence, and capability compound over time. **If you are excited to build the agent systems behind the next generation of AI applications, create fully\-automated software workflows, and turn ambitious research ideas into real\-world impact, Peano AI is the place for you.**

distributed training. * Strong systems debugging skills. * Comfort working across model code, runtime, infrastructure, and product requirements. * High ownership and the ability to operate effectively jobs.title: Junior Database Developer
jobs.description: **About Peregrine** Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA. Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership. We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people. As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become. **People first. Ownership always.** We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation come before competence. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else. At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk. At Peregrine Advisors, you will build and maintain the queries, stored procedures, and views that make a federal agency's enterprise data platform useful. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are. This is a full\-time W\-2 position with a salary of $80,000 to $95,000 per year. It is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement is expected to be one to two days a week on site in DC. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination. **Your first assignment** In your first assignment, a senior developer will guide you as you take on your assigned components. Depending on the assignment, you may: * Build and maintain Structured Query Language (SQL) queries, stored procedures, and views in Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL\-compatible). * Work with data from Amazon DynamoDB and Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3\). * Contribute to logical data models and database\-design decisions within the established platform architecture, with reviews that explain what to change and why. * Build reliable data loads from S3, tune queries with guidance, and work within governed access. Over time, you will grow toward responsibility for physical design. The work is real and hard, and it matters. This first assignment is a starting point, not the shape of your career here. **Requirements** * 1\+ years of database development, software development, or comparable practical experience * Bachelor's degree * Working knowledge of SQL, stored procedures, and views on Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL\-compatible) * Familiarity with Amazon DynamoDB and Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3\) * Query tuning with guidance from a senior developer * Exposure to extract, transform, and load (ETL) and extract, load, and transform (ELT) patterns and data integration across Amazon Web Services (AWS) data services * Awareness of data security controls, including encryption, access management, and auditing * Basic exposure to loading data from S3 into the platform stores and to Open Database Connectivity (ODBC) and Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) * Introductory familiarity with logical data modeling and the ability to contribute to database\-design decisions within an established platform architecture * Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel **Preferred** * An entry\-level AWS certification, such as Cloud Practitioner, or the interest in earning one * Exposure to query blocking, locking, and deadlocks * Interest in cloud\-native application support in AWS using continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) and development, security, and operations (DevSecOps) practices * Exposure to physical design, including Aurora and DynamoDB schema and index design, or the motivation to grow into it * Federal information technology or high\-volume transaction experience * Interest in artificial intelligence (AI)\-assisted developer tooling **Who you are** You care about getting data right and want a career in database development. You ask for help when you need it and put feedback to use quickly. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task. **What you bring** * A foundation in SQL and relational databases, with working knowledge of stored procedures and views on Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL\-compatible) and a desire to deepen it across DynamoDB and S3\. * Practical habits in query tuning, data loading, and connectivity, applied with guidance and improved on feedback. * Clear communication about what you have finished, what is blocking you, and where you need support. * Careful execution in work where accuracy and auditability are essential. **When we talk** Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned. **Benefits** Medical, dental, and vision with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer\-paid life, accidental death, and short\-term and long\-term disability insurance; a 401(k) matched 100% up to 4% of salary, vesting immediately; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education. **What we offer** You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments with onboarding, sponsored training, and professional development. **What we commit to** As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better. We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply. Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. *Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.*

jobs.title: Senior Developer
jobs.description: **About Peregrine** Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA. Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership. We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people. As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become. **People first. Ownership always.** We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation come before competence. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else. At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk. At Peregrine Advisors, you will own the technical design and delivery of a defined application or solution area. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will learn new systems and tools, take on greater responsibility, and help develop the firm's capabilities, tools, and lines of business. We move our best to where the hardest problems are. This is a full\-time W\-2 position with a salary of $150,000 to $170,000 per year. It is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement is expected to be one to two days a week on site in DC. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination. **Your first project** Your first project will likely have you making the design decisions that connect a solution's components and carrying the result through production. Depending on the assignment, you may: * Design how the components of an application or solution area fit together, then guide their implementation. * Build cloud\-native systems whose automated operation replaces manual process. * Build and maintain the delivery path itself, the pipelines and automated tests, rather than merely using them. * Set the pattern for development assisted by artificial intelligence (AI), including tools such as Amazon Q Developer. * Lead the design, development, and implementation of Python\-based enterprise solutions that meet client requirements. * Lead quality development practices, including test\-driven development, code reviews, and application security standards. * Develop accurate project estimates and support project planning, delivery forecasting, and resource allocation activities. You deliver an integrated solution whose parts work together and hold one quality bar. You automate the validations and workflows that used to live in a spreadsheet, and you build the developers around you through the way you work. This is where you start, not the shape of your career here. **Requirements** * 7\+ years of software development experience * Bachelor's degree * Strong hands\-on experience with cloud\-native development on Amazon Web Services (AWS), including AWS Lambda, Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3\), Amazon Simple Queue Service (SQS), and Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS) * Strong experience working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or Oracle * Strong experience working with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB or DynamoDB * Advanced knowledge of object\-oriented programming, software architecture, design patterns, database design, data modeling, and distributed systems * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills * Experience leading delivery within an Agile framework such as Scrum or Kanban, using an issue tracker such as Jira * Experience with AI\-assisted developer tooling, such as Amazon Q Developer or GitHub Copilot * Demonstrated ability to lead a development team and to mentor developers * Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage executive leadership, business stakeholders, and technical teams * Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel **Preferred** * An Amazon Web Services certification, or a Python certification * Federal information technology experience * Experience in a client\-facing consulting environment leading technical delivery teams * Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps best practices **Who you are** You take personal ownership of what you build, and you spend real time making the developers around you better, through code review, through explaining your reasoning, and through the standard you set. Hard calls come to you because you make them well. When priorities shift, you keep the team steady and productive. You communicate clearly, adapt across roles and clients, and care about creating public value. You experiment, learn from failure, and try again quickly. You would rather own an outcome than simply be given a task. **What you bring** * Deep command of modern cloud development, with the range to develop something new or improve what already runs. * Strong delivery habits in version control, automated testing, code review, secure coding, and accessibility, with the standing to set those habits for a team. * The judgment to choose among competing solution approaches, resolve design tradeoffs across components, and take responsibility for the technical direction of your assigned area. * The ability to explain your work plainly to the people who depend on it and to listen carefully to what they need. * Precision in work where accuracy and auditability are not optional. You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver. **When we talk** Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned. **Benefits** Medical, dental, and vision with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer\-paid life, accidental death, and short\-term and long\-term disability insurance; a 401(k) matched 100% up to 4% of salary, vesting immediately; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education. **What we offer** You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship. **What we commit to** As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better. We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply. Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. *Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.*

jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer – Manual & Automation Testing
jobs.description: **Senior QA Engineer – Manual \& Automation Testing** ===================================================== **Experience: 4\+ Years** **Role Overview** ----------------- We are looking for a skilled Senior QA Engineer with 4\+ years of experience in manual and automation testing. The candidate will be responsible for developing automation frameworks, API testing, performance testing, Google Apps Script automation, and ensuring overall software quality. The role also includes mentoring junior team members and leveraging AI tools to improve testing efficiency. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **1\. Automation \& Manual Testing** * Design, develop, and maintain automation frameworks using Selenium, Playwright, or equivalent tools. * Develop automated test scripts using Java, Python, or JavaScript. * Execute functional, regression, smoke, sanity, and exploratory testing. * Create test scenarios, test cases, and maintain comprehensive test coverage. * Identify, document, and track defects using JIRA. * Troubleshoot automation failures and ensure reliable test execution. ### **2\. API \& Performance Testing** * Perform API testing and automation using Postman, RestAssured, or equivalent tools. * Validate API responses, payloads, headers, and error handling. * Conduct performance testing using JMeter, LoadRunner, or equivalent tools. * Analyse test results and identify performance bottlenecks. ### **3\. Workflow Automation \& CI/CD** * Develop automation solutions using Google Apps Script for Google Docs, Sheets, and other Google Workspace tools. * Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or equivalent tools. * Leverage AI tools and prompt engineering to improve testing, automation, and productivity. * Exposure to AI workflow automation is an added advantage. ### **4\. Collaboration \& Mentoring** * Participate in requirement discussions, sprint planning, and test planning. * Collaborate with developers and stakeholders to resolve defects. * Mentor junior team members in manual and automation testing. * Contribute to QA strategy and continuous process improvements. **Required Skills \& Qualifications** ------------------------------------- * 4\+ years of experience in manual and automation testing. * Strong knowledge of Selenium, Playwright, or equivalent tools. * Proficiency in Java, Python, or JavaScript. * Experience with API automation using Postman, RestAssured, or similar tools. * Hands\-on experience with JMeter, LoadRunner, or equivalent performance testing tools. * Experience with Google Apps Script and workflow automation. * Understanding of CI/CD, SDLC, STLC, and Agile methodologies. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills. * Experience mentoring junior QA engineers. **Added Advantage** ------------------- * Strong SQL skills with MySQL, BigQuery, or similar databases. * Experience in database validation and query optimization. * Familiarity with Cypress, TestNG, JUnit, or PyTest. * Experience with Git and cloud\-based testing. * Exposure to AI\-assisted testing and AI workflow automation. **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- * A proactive QA professional who takes ownership of product quality, develops reliable automation solutions, identifies potential risks, and supports team growth through mentoring and knowledge sharing.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us. **Job Description** AECOM is seeking a talented and motivated **Civil Roadway/Highway Engineer** to join our Transportation team in Tampa, Florida. In this role, the successful candidate will contribute to the planning, design, and delivery of roadway and transportation infrastructure projects for clients including FDOT, local governments, toll authorities, and other public agencies. The Civil Engineer II will support project managers and senior engineers in developing roadway, pavement, drainage, maintenance of traffic (MOT), signing and pavement marking, and ADA\-compliance improvements. The position offers opportunities to work on complex transportation projects while further developing technical expertise and progressing toward Professional Engineer (PE) licensure. **Key Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:** * Prepare roadway design plans, profiles, typical sections, and cross sections using OpenRoads Designer and MicroStation. * Perform engineering calculations and technical analyses for transportation projects. * Develop pavement evaluation reports and rehabilitation recommendations. * Assist in the preparation of roadway design reports, engineering studies, and technical documentation. * Design signing and pavement marking plans in accordance with MUTCD and agency standards. * Prepare ADA compliant pedestrian facility improvements, including curb ramps, sidewalks, and crosswalks. * Support maintenance of traffic (MOT) and traffic control plan development. * Perform quantity calculations and assist with cost estimating. * Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams including drainage, structures, traffic engineering, survey, environmental, and utility disciplines. * Participate in field reviews, site visits, and construction support activities. * Support quality control reviews and implementation of company design standards. * Communicate effectively with project managers, clients, and project stakeholders. **Technical Skills** * Roadway design * Pavement engineering * Transportation corridor modeling * Horizontal and vertical alignment development * Maintenance of traffic design * ADA compliance * Signing and pavement marking * Quantity calculations * Cost estimating * Engineering report preparation * Multidisciplinary project coordination **Career Growth Opportunities** The Civil Engineer II position provides opportunities to: * Lead design tasks on increasingly complex transportation projects. * Expand technical expertise in roadway and transportation engineering. * Prepare for and obtain Professional Engineer licensure. * Develop project management and client\-facing experience. * Advance into senior engineering and project leadership roles. **Qualifications** **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering plus 2 years of transportation engineering experience or demonstrated equivalency of education and/or experience. * Engineer Intern (EI/EIT) certification. * Demonstrated experience with roadway design and plan production. * Demonstrated proficiency with Bentley OpenRoads Designer and MicroStation. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with DOT, municipal, county, or toll\-road transportation projects. * Experience preparing: + Roadway design plans + Pavement design and rehabilitation recommendations + Maintenance of Traffic (MOT) plans + Signing and pavement marking plans + ADA compliance improvements * Familiarity with AASHTO and MUTCD design standards. * Experience with ProjectWise and transportation design workflows. * Working knowledge of AutoCAD, SignCAD, Synchro, or related transportation software. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to work effectively in a team\-oriented environment. **Additional Information** * Sponsorship for US employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position. * Hybrid work location model * Collaborative A/E office environment * Relocation is not available for this position At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in\-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.*** **About AECOM** AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD\&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well\-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan. AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public\- and private\-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16\.1 billion in fiscal year 2025\. Learn more at aecom.com. **What makes AECOM a great place to work** You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects \- both in your local community and on a global scale \- that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting\-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award\-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. endpoint security tools, device management platforms, and related solutions. * Support Microsoft endpoint management platforms, including Intune, Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM), application deployment, device management, virtual environment, and user experience issues. * Provide advanced support for business users, including executive stakeholders, and participate in on\-call support rotations as needed. * Support collaboration technologies and meeting room solutions, including Microsoft Teams Rooms, Logitech technologies, and related platforms. * Evaluate hardware and software requests and recommend solutions aligned with business needs, security requirements, and technology standards. * Develop and maintain documentation, standard operating procedures, work instructions, and knowledge base articles. * Identify and implement opportunities to improve endpoint performance, operational efficiency, automation, and user experience. * Contribute to technology projects and initiatives that support the ongoing modernization of the Digital Workplace environment. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education, technical training, certifications, and experience. * Approximately 3\+ years of experience in endpoint engineering, enterprise systems administration, digital workplace technology, desktop engineering, or a related technical role. * Experience working with endpoint management technologies, deployment processes, application packaging, automation, scripting, or enterprise endpoint standards. * Working knowledge of: + Microsoft Intune + MECM/SCCM + Windows 11 + Microsoft 365 + Active Directory / Microsoft Entra ID + Group Policy + TCP/IP networking and endpoint connectivity troubleshooting * Experience supporting endpoint deployment, software distribution, patch management, compliance programs, and endpoint lifecycle management. * Familiarity with PowerShell scripting and a willingness to continue developing automation capabilities. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and collaboration skills. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience supporting macOS devices, mobile device management, endpoint virtualization platforms, printing solutions, or executive support environments. * Industry certifications such as: + **Microsoft Certified**: Endpoint Administrator Associate + **Microsoft Certified**: Modern Desktop Administrator Associate + ITIL Foundation + jobs.title: Engineer, Technology II
jobs.description: **Company Description** **About AbbVie** AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience \- and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube. **Job Description** Technical expert responsible for independently identifying, engineering, and optimizing data, reporting, and integration solutions that address critical business needs within Clinical Supply Management (CSM). Serves as the reporting and systems\-data subject matter expert for the Clinical Supply Systems (CSS) group — designing and delivering operational reports, metrics, and dashboards from GxP clinical supply systems, engineering and supporting system\-to\-system integrations with external vendor platforms, and continuously improving the processes and master data that those systems depend on. Additionally serves as Business System Owner for assigned CSM systems, accountable for their ongoing health, change management, business continuity and end\-user support. Continuously seeks to improve existing methods and processes. Demonstrates proficiency across a broad range of information technology engineering techniques, including SQL development, data integration, reporting and data visualization, API\-based system integration, and database and data\-warehouse concepts. **Responsibilities:** * **Reporting, metrics and analytics development.** Independently design, develop, test and deploy operational and management reports, dashboards and KPI views against clinical supply systems using Jaspersoft and SQL against Oracle and PostgreSQL data sources. Gather requirements directly from business stakeholders, translate them into report specifications, build parameterized and filterable reports with dynamic titling and drill\-down, publish to the reporting server, and own them through user acceptance and ongoing maintenance. Recent representative work includes shipping and transfer metrics summary reporting for the packaging and distribution sites and an integrated kit\-utilization report supporting quarterly waste, cost and volume assessment of expired comparator kits. * **Business System Ownership.** Act as Business System Owner for assigned Clinical Supply Management systems, in line with the Clinical Supply Systems Owner role definition. Accountable for the day\-to\-day health, configuration and supportability of the owned system(s), including: change management and change control; business continuity and disaster recovery planning and testing; interface and integration error handling and monitoring; definition and documentation of business roles and system access; coordination of upgrades, patches and vendor releases with business and IT partners; periodic review and system lifecycle documentation; and end\-user communication for outages, releases and process changes. Serves as the primary point of contact between the business user community, global IT and the external system vendor for the owned system(s), and represents the system in cross\-functional governance forums. * **System integration engineering and support.** Engineer, test and support integrations between CSM systems and external vendor platforms — including the TRACK / CSS Inventory to Sensitech SensiWatch temperature\-monitoring integration and associated Veeva Vault end\-to\-end flows. Design and implement API logging and monitoring mechanisms to make integration behavior observable; coordinate the required database, network ACL and firewall configuration across Development and Production; and drive end\-to\-end testing with internal IT and external vendor engineering teams. * **Integration issue triage and root cause analysis.** Serve as first\-line technical investigator for interface and integration failures. Correlate application logs, API responses and database activity to establish root cause, distinguish vendor\-side from AbbVie\-side faults, and communicate findings directly to external vendor technical contacts and internal stakeholders. Resolve issues of low to moderate complexity independently and escalate appropriately, engaging global IT support and external system providers when required. * **Master data management.** Own the input, administration and quality of master data in CSM systems, including item master classifications, data mappings and the representation of external partners and depots. Assess the downstream impact of master data changes on dependent system functionality, reporting and integrations before implementation. * **Process optimization and automation.** Identify and deliver automation and optimization opportunities that increase efficiency within CSM. Prep , GxP compliance, data security and the software development lifecycle. **Qualifications** **Required:** * Bachelor's degree in a relevant field and at least 5 years of relevant experience, **or** Master's degree in a relevant field and at least 4 years of relevant experience. * Strong, demonstrable SQL development skills, including query authoring, tuning and troubleshooting against relational databases (Oracle and/or PostgreSQL). * Hands\-on experience developing and deploying reports in Jaspersoft / JasperReports, including parameterization, scheduling and distribution. * Working understanding of relational database design, data models and data\-warehouse concepts, and the ability to navigate an unfamiliar schema to locate and validate data. * Experience supporting or engineering system\-to\-system integrations, including API/interface concepts, log analysis and structured root cause investigation. * Ability to work directly with business stakeholders to elicit requirements and translate them into technical deliverables; strong customer orientation and prioritization skills. * Effective written and verbal communication skills, including communicating technical findings to non\-technical stakeholders and to external vendor technical teams. * Goal\-oriented, independent working style with exceptional follow\-up skills, and the ability to think and act across multiple functions. * Demonstrated ownership of a business system or application, including accountability for change management, access and role definition, vendor release coordination and end\-user communication. * Familiarity with clinical supply management systems (IRTs, Signant’s PMD, Loftware’s P360, Master Control’s Mx) and with vendor platforms such as Sensitech SensiWatch. **Preferred:** * Experience with scripting or automation (e.g. Python) for data processing and operational tooling. * Experience preparing training materials, SOPs or work instructions and delivering system training. * Prior experience in clinical drug development, clinical supply chain, in a GMP regulated environment. * Experience with computer system validation, UAT, change control, periodic review, disaster recovery testing and GxP documentation practices. **Additional Information** Applicable only to applicants applying to a position in any location with pay disclosure requirements under state or local law: * The compensation range described below is the range of possible base pay compensation that the Company believes in good faith it will pay for this role at the time of this posting based on the job grade for this position. The position provides ongoing proactive product support for assigned accounts. The customer experience aspect of this role will focus on increasing customer loyalty; securing retention; and driving value expansion at assigned accounts. **What You’ll Work On** * Responsible for implementing and maintaining the effectiveness of the quality system. * Provides technical Level I and Level II phone and on\-site support to proactively maintain product performance or resolve customer complaints for hardware; software; and reagent issues. * Level I support is defined to a specific set of error codes that could be repaired in less than1\.5 hrs. * Level II support is defined as any error code excluding Level I that would be resolved in more than 1\.5 hrs. * Performs proactive service support activities to maintain system performance. * Applies standard troubleshooting tools or concepts to identify the real issue and its root cause. * Determines level of urgency of service support requests; develops recommendations and implements solutions that reflect customer and Abbott business needs. * Record accurate and timely documentation of customer complaints and the action taken to resolve the concern. * Plan and prioritize customer visits and activities to do in each account. * Prepare, schedule, and execute training events with customers to improve customer self\-sufficiency by developing the customer’s ability to troubleshoot/repair analyzers and increase knowledge of component replacement and assays. * Coordinate order delivery and billing of products and/or services in assigned accounts. Monitor inventory and replenish accordingly. * Partner with the Enterprise Account Manager and/or Sales Executive to develop account\-specific lab strategy and execution throughout the commercial cycle and participate in customer business reviews. * Develop/preserve strong relationships to gain meaningful insights that will allow for value expansion opportunities. * Responsible for achieving revenue generation goals in assigned accounts. * Accountable for customer satisfaction; loyalty and value expansion revenue in assigned accounts. Makes decisions on parts utilization within the pre\-approved budget range for the role. Parts utilization decisions outside of the pre\-approved budget range require management approval. jobs.title: Full Stack Software Developer
jobs.description: **Job Title : Senior Full Stack Engineer** **Qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related discipline** **Location: Remote** **Benefits : Health Insurance , 401K** **Position Description** The Senior Full Stack Engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable, secure, and high\-quality web applications using modern TypeScript\-based technologies. This role requires strong expertise in frontend and backend engineering, cloud\-native application development, automated testing, infrastructure as code, and modern software delivery practices. The engineer will work closely with product managers, designers, and other engineering team members to translate business requirements and user experiences into reliable, maintainable, and performant software solutions. The role will also contribute to architectural decisions, shared platform components, engineering standards, and the continuous improvement of development workflows. **About the Role** This is an opportunity to work on a modern, cloud\-native product ecosystem built around a TypeScript\-first technology stack. The successful candidate will contribute across the full software development lifecycle—from designing component\-driven user interfaces and REST APIs to implementing cloud infrastructure, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and secure multi\-tenant capabilities. The role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys working in a collaborative environment, takes ownership of technical outcomes, and is passionate about building scalable products with strong engineering foundations. **Key Responsibilities** **Software Development \& Architecture** * Design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, and high\-performance web applications. * Build full\-stack features using **TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Node.js, and REST APIs**. * Develop reusable, maintainable, and component\-driven frontend applications using **React, TSX, and Vite**. * Implement backend services using **Node.js and TypeScript**, following clean architecture and maintainable coding practices. * Design and implement APIs using **schema\-first development** and well\-defined API contracts. * Develop middleware for authentication, authorization, validation, logging, error handling, and request processing. * Contribute to architectural decisions involving monorepos, multi\-app frontends, shared packages, and modular application design. * Identify performance bottlenecks and implement solutions to improve application scalability and reliability. **Frontend Engineering** * Build responsive, accessible, and user\-friendly interfaces using React and TSX. * Develop reusable UI components and shared component libraries. * Implement effective state management patterns for complex frontend applications. * Work with product designers and UX teams to translate Figma designs into high\-quality user experiences. * Apply UX/HCI principles to ensure intuitive navigation, usability, and cross\-device compatibility. * Optimize frontend performance, bundle size, loading times, and overall application responsiveness. **Backend \& API Development** * Design and implement robust RESTful APIs using Node.js and TypeScript. * Define and maintain API schemas, validation rules, and contracts. * Implement business logic, middleware, error handling, and service integrations. * Work with both **DynamoDB and PostgreSQL / relational databases** based on application requirements. * Design data models, queries, indexes, and persistence strategies for performance and scalability. * Manage database schema changes and version\-controlled migrations using **Liquibase** where applicable. * Ensure APIs follow security, reliability, observability, and maintainability best practices. **Cloud, Infrastructure \& DevOps** * Develop and deploy cloud\-native applications using **AWS Lambda, API Gateway, CloudFront, and Docker**. * Contribute to serverless architecture and cloud infrastructure design. * Define and manage infrastructure using **Pulumi with TypeScript** and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles. * Implement secure, repeatable, and environment\-specific infrastructure provisioning. * Collaborate with DevOps and engineering teams to improve deployment reliability and operational readiness. * Assist in troubleshooting production issues, identifying root causes, and implementing preventive measures. **Testing \& Quality Engineering** * Develop and maintain automated **unit, integration, and end\-to\-end tests**. * Use **Vitest** for unit and integration testing and **Playwright** for browser\-based E2E testing. * Implement test strategies covering functional behavior, API contracts, UI workflows, and regression scenarios. * Create and maintain snapshot tests where appropriate. * Ensure adequate code coverage and reliable automated test execution in CI pipelines. * Participate in code reviews and promote clean code, maintainability, and engineering best practices. * eholders to deliver product features. * Participate in technical discussions, design reviews, sprint planning, and estimation activities. * Break down complex requirements into clear, actionable engineering tasks. * Review code and provide constructive feedback to maintain quality and consistency. * Mentor junior and mid\-level engineers and support their technical growth. * Stay current with emerging technologies, cloud\-native practices, and modern web development trends. * Take ownership of assigned deliverables and proactively communicate risks, dependencies, and progress. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with **7\+ years of relevant software development experience**, or equivalent practical experience. * Strong hands\-on experience with **TypeScript and JavaScript**. * Proficiency in **React, TSX, Vite, and component\-driven frontend development**. * Strong backend development experience with **Node.js and TypeScript**. * Experience designing and developing **REST APIs** and implementing middleware. * Knowledge of **schema\-first API development** and contract\-driven engineering. * Strong experience with **unit, integration, and E2E testing**. * Hands\-on experience with **Vitest and Playwright**. * Experience with **AWS Lambda, API Gateway, CloudFront, and Docker**. * Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code using **Pulumi**, preferably with TypeScript. * Strong knowledge of **DynamoDB and PostgreSQL or other relational databases**. * Experience with database schema management and migrations; knowledge of **Liquibase** is preferred. * Experience implementing authentication and authorization using **SSO, SAML, OAuth, and RBAC**. * Understanding of **multi\-tenant application architecture** and secure data isolation. * Experience creating and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using **GitHub Actions**. * Strong understanding of Git, pull requests, code reviews, and trunk\-based or similar collaborative development workflows. * Experience working with **monorepos, multi\-app frontends, and shared packages/libraries**. * Familiarity with **Figma** and the ability to collaborate effectively with design teams. * Strong understanding of responsive design, accessibility, cross\-browser compatibility, and UX/HCI principles. * Excellent problem\-solving, communication, collaboration, and ownership skills. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience designing and operating production\-grade serverless applications on AWS. * Experience with advanced React state management and frontend architecture patterns. * Familiarity with API schema tools and standards such as OpenAPI or equivalent schema\-first approaches. * Experience building shared design systems or component libraries. * Experience with observability, structured logging, monitoring, and production troubleshooting. * Experience working in Agile / Scrum or similar product development environments. * Experience mentoring engineers and contributing to technical architecture decisions. * Exposure to performance optimization, accessibility standards, and secure software development practices. **Key Competencies** * **Technical Excellence:** Writes clean, scalable, testable, and maintainable code. * **Problem Solving:** Analyzes complex technical problems and develops effective solutions. * **Ownership:** Takes responsibility for deliverables, quality, and production readiness. * **Collaboration:** Works effectively with engineering, product, design, and QA teams. * **Communication:** Clearly communicates technical decisions, risks, and progress. * **Continuous Learning:** Keeps up with modern technologies, engineering practices, and cloud\-native development. * **Mentorship:** Supports team development and promotes knowledge sharing. Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $75,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Health insurance * Paid time off Education: * Bachelor's (Preferred) Location: * Remote (Preferred) Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Field Engineer II
jobs.description: **Field Service Technician \- Network \& Technology Services :** **Acuative** is seeking a dependable and technically capable hands\-on **Field Service Technician** to provide installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and Smart Hands support for network and technology infrastructure at customer locations. Technicians work with a wide variety of network, communications, computing, and low\-voltage infrastructure and frequently coordinate with remote Network Operations Centers (NOCs), engineers, project coordinators, and customer technical teams to complete installations and resolve service issues. This is a full time benefits eligible position that includes a company vehicle, gas card for vehicle, inventory, and training. Prior field service, IT, networking, telecommunications, or structured cabling experience is preferred. However, candidates with a strong technical background, mechanical aptitude, and a demonstrated willingness to learn are encouraged to apply. Acuative provides paid training and technical support for the work our technicians perform. Technicians serve as the Onsite Smart Hands resource, performing physical installation, cabling, testing, troubleshooting, equipment replacement, and other hands\-on tasks while working with remote technical resources when configuration or advanced troubleshooting is required. This position requires a person willing to go to new places. Tickets can be assigned four or more hours away to provide installation and maintenance services to voice and data networks, servers, computer systems, retail technology systems, and other network\-based hardware. **Acuative technicians are guaranteed forty (40\) hours of pay per week even if not dispatched for forty hours.** To be eligible for this role you must have a clear driver’s license (no more than 4 points), have the Covid\-19 vaccination, and willing to work mostly M\-F with opportunity for overtime and call out pay after hours and weekends. This position often works alone, and qualified applicants must be able to lift up to fifty pounds above head and climb a ladder. **Acuative is a drug free workplace.** **Overview :** Acuative, the nation's leading independent provider of telecommunications field services, seeks a Field Service Technician. The successful candidate will spend the majority of their time covering the (MARKET) area providing installation and maintenance services to voice and data networks, servers, computer systems, retail technology systems, and other network\-based hardware. **Primary Duties and Responsibilities :** The position involves a variety of tasks including but not limited to: * Install, replace, relocate, rack, stack, mount, and provide Smart Hands support for routers, switches, wireless access points, firewalls, cellular gateways, SD\-WAN equipment, servers, circuits, telephony and other network\-based hardware. * Perform physical installation and replacement of equipment from a variety of manufacturers and technology platforms, including circuit extensions, structured cabling, fixed wireless, and Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite solutions. * Perform equipment cutovers and migrations while working with remote engineers, NOCs, project teams, and customer technical resources. * Locate, identify, label, and document telecommunications circuits, circuit IDs, demarcation points, network equipment, ports, cabling, and associated infrastructure. * Troubleshoot copper cabling and connectivity using appropriate test equipment, including cable testers, toner/probe sets, and related tools. Perform circuit extensions and other low\-voltage cabling work as required. * Conduct site surveys and site audits to document existing infrastructure, equipment, cabling, power availability, installation requirements, and other site conditions. * Install LEO satellite and fixed wireless equipment, including exterior mounting, antenna installation, cable routing from exterior to interior locations, and associated indoor network equipment. Installation of Fixed Wireless Antennas, cables and hardware. * Carry and position tools, networking equipment, mounting hardware, ladders, satellite installation components, ballast/cinder blocks, and other materials required for field installations. * Complete all required job deliverables accurately and on time. Deliverables may include photographs, ticket notes, equipment and serial\-number information, Microsoft Excel survey forms, sign\-off documents, installation checklists, test results, and customer\-specific electronic forms or applications. * Maintain assigned company vehicle, inventory, tools, test equipment, and safety equipment according to departmental standards. * Ability to work off a lift or ladder at heights up to 30 feet or more. **Preferred Qualifications :** * Working knowledge of networking hardware and topologies. * Previous experience in IT field services, telecommunications, networking, structured cabling, computer hardware, electronics, or a related technical field. * Ability to identify and work with routers, switches, wireless access points, firewalls, cellular gateways, modems, servers, telecommunications circuits, and related hardware. * Basic understanding of telecommunications circuits, demarcation points, circuit extensions, and connectivity troubleshooting. * Knowledge of computing systems hardware with the ability to provide break/fix support for desktop PC and/or servers. * Physical installations of a wide variety of hardware including routers, switches, WAPs, servers, POS systems, digital signage systems, and associated peripheral equipment. * Ability to provide configuration support for a variety of technology platforms through console and remote applications. * Understanding of telephony systems (VOIP, PBX, Key Systems) with an ability to provide hands\-on hardware and troubleshooting support. * Experience with LEC circuit identification and extensions. * Familiarity with cabling standards and the ability to pull and terminate cabling in a variety of customer environments. * Ability to operate basic power tools – drills, saws, etc. * Work on ladders and lifts where required. * Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications (Excel \& Word). * Ability to follow detailed job documents. * Must be willing to travel as needed to meet customer SLAs. * On\-call, after hours, and weekend work may be required. * Must possess a valid drivers’ license with good driving record. * Experience installing LEO Satellite (such as Starlink) and/or Fixed Wireless antennas. * Ability to work off a lift or ladder at heights up to 30 feet or more. **Education \& Certifications :** * Associate’s degree in information technology or equivalent experience. * CompTIA networking, Cisco, Cabling, BICSII, Satellite, PBX or VoIP system certifications a plus! * Selected candidates will be required to attend a hardware and cabling training course at our Global Technology Center in Strongsville, OH. **The Ideal Candidate :** The ideal Field Service Technician **is someone** **we can depend on**. You do not need to know every piece of equipment you will encounter on day one. Technology, customers, and project requirements continually change, and training and remote technical support are available. What matters is having a solid technical foundation, the ability and desire to learn, good judgment, and the willingness to work through unfamiliar problems. Our strongest technicians are comfortable working independently, traveling wherever the work requires, communicating professionally with everyone they encounter, and taking ownership of their assignments. They understand when to troubleshoot independently, when to engage remote technical resources, and when a customer Scope of Work requires approval before making a change. If you enjoy hands\-on technology, solving problems in the field, learning new systems, and working in an environment where no two assignments are exactly the same, this position may be a strong fit.

jobs.title: Senior Data Architect
jobs.description: Opportunity As a Senior Customer Experience Orchestration Data Architect at Adobe, you will lead the development of advanced, secure data solutions for our innovative digital marketing platforms. We craft data strategy, architecture, SQL and governance for customer solutions, including end\-to\-end profiles, segmentation, journeys, and campaigns! What You’ll Do Provide deep experience to build data solutions across multiple Adobe products and cloud platforms aligned with enterprise data strategy. Engage closely with customers and Adobe team to facilitate data discovery by evaluating systems and business processes. Analyze customer sources, data movement, data granularity, relationships, data format, etc. Unify disparate data (e.g., sales, CRM, analytics data, etc.) to meet customers’ digital marketing use cases. Lead and develop conceptual, logical, and physical data models for multi\-solution delivery. Establish frameworks for data quality, define standards, master data management, data services, data governance, data modeling, tools, data security, privacy, and compliance with industry regulations (PII, PCI, HIPAA, GDPR, etc.). We develop and champion data architecture guidelines via detailed documentation. These encompass architectural blueprints, ERDs, data flow diagrams, source\-to\-target mappings, data dictionaries, metadata catalogs, governance frameworks, guardrails, and security and compliance protocols. We engage with cross\-disciplinary groups and Adobe professionals to identify customer demands. We provide data layout and strategic blueprints, advocating for scalable, secure resolutions. Assume the role of a liaison to promptly tackle technical obstacles. We develop strategies for growing data volumes, tools, and integrations, while aligning with customers’ objectives. We deliver mentorship on data architecture to customers and consultants to align work with targets. We deliver Adobe platform data lake and real\-time customer profile to get ready for data ingestion and activation. Employ REST APIs, Postman, and basic scripting to automate and streamline the implementation and setup. Develop and construct data ingestion solutions for streaming and batch processing, online and offline data within AEP. Collaborate with data engineers to develop and implement ETL/ELT pipelines for data collection and extraction. We improve data query performance across platforms by tuning models and adhering to guidelines and ensure product guardrails are followed and deployed in solutions Requirements Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field or equivalent experience. 10\+ years of data architecture, modeling, SQL, and working with customers! Expert proficiency in crafting customer\-centric database models, datasets (e.g., CRM, Call Center, Marketing, Offline, Point of Sale, etc.) with relational, hierarchical (e.g., RDBMS, Columnar, Data Warehouse, BI, Document, Semantic layer modeling, Data Lakes, OLTP \& OLAP, etc.). Advanced skills in SQL development (e.g., functions, data transformations, arrays, joins details, stored procedures, data analysis).
