jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description: **Aegis Overview** Aegis operates at the intersection of data science and global brand integrity. We build proprietary intelligence systems that protect telecommunications companies from fraud, channel abuse, and partner risk — and we do it at scale, in real time, across multiple continents. Aegis utilizes the most sophisticated Internet and mobile web surveillance and capture tools available today to deliver: · Business Analysis and Analytics for Brand Protection and Compliance · Third Party Partner Risk Assessment, Onboarding, and Monitoring · Fraud Detection and Prevention for the Digital Customer Experience · Market Intelligence · Operational Insight and Transformation **Aegis Solutions** Aegis provides multi\-level investigative solutions to its clients through proprietary software tools that integrate and transform data into actionable information with intuitive user interfaces and dashboards. The Company operates two highly focused business units: · Brand Protection and Compliance · Multi\-source Business Intelligence and Analytics Every solution implementation is customized and integrated to meet the individual customer’s processes and objectives. In our brand and partner protection products and services, we “connect the dots” using proprietary software to create insight as well as partner and program visibility across business channels to improve performance, risk mitigation, profitability, revenue optimization, and management efficiency. We integrate our customers’ data with open\-source information from across the Internet to deliver customized, actionable, world class business intelligence. **Position: Data Scientist** We're looking for a Data Scientist who wants to own hard problems end\-to\-end: designing models, deploying them into production pipelines, and translating results into decisions that matter to senior stakeholders. This role sits inside our Data Intelligence Department alongside engineers, analysts, and domain experts who move fast and expect the same from you.This position is based in any one of Aegis Mobile’s offices in Tysons Corner, VA, Mobile, AL, or Columbia, MD, with the potential for hybrid or remote work. ***Job Summary*** We are seeking a detail\-oriented and analytically strong Data Scientist to contribute to and create advanced data\-focused solutions supporting our global telecommunications clients. As a member of the Data Intelligence Department the ideal candidate will regularly integrate knowledge of data science, applied AI, and machine learning for predictive modeling and analysis. This is a position requiring focus and flexibility, independence, effective organizational skills, and a willingness to improvise when crafting novel solutions. As a member of the Data Intelligence Department the ideal candidate will investigate and capture the data and intelligence needed to deliver business analytics for brand protection, partner risk assessment, and operational insight and efficiency. This is a position requiring excellent analytical and communication skills, understanding of the software development lifecycle, and confidence in presenting to senior\-level stakeholders. **Key responsibilities:** · Design, build, and deploy predictive and ML models that support telecom fraud detection, partner risk scoring, and operational analytics. · Architect and maintain data pipelines — batch and real\-time — in Azure, and contribute to a scalable, well\-governed data ecosystem. · Build agentic AI workflows and LLM\-based applications using frameworks such as LangChain or Azure AI Studio, including RAG systems and enterprise workflow automation. · Translate complex model outputs into clear, actionable recommendations for non\-technical senior stakeholders — in writing and in person. · Create dashboards and analytical artifacts in Power BI that surface insights across business units. · Evaluate emerging AI/ML capabilities and prototype solutions for future deployment. · Collaborate across teams to identify and scope new opportunities for data science and AI integration. **Basic Qualifications:** · 4\+ years of professional experience in data science or ML engineering. · Advanced Python skills — production\-quality code, not just notebooks. · Strong command of SQL and Azure data services (Azure Data Factory, Synapse, or equivalent). · Hands\-on ML experience: feature engineering, model selection, validation, and deployment. · Familiarity with LLM workflows: embeddings, vector stores, RAG, and modern AI architecture. · Experience with Power BI or Tableau for stakeholder\-facing dashboards and reporting. · Version control discipline — Git or Azure Repos. · Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field. · **Preferred Qualifications** · Experience implementing agentic AI workflows or LLM orchestration (LangChain, Azure AI Studio, Semantic Kernel, or similar). · Hands\-on work with Azure ML, Databricks, Foundry, or comparable MLOps platforms. · Background in anomaly detection, fraud modeling, or sentiment analysis. · Prior telecom industry experience. · Understanding of data governance, PII handling, and enterprise data security standards. **Additional Requirements** · In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification process upon hire. **Aegis is unable to provide employment sponsorship for this position.** *·* All people hired are required, without exception, to pass a criminal background check and a drug screen *· Candidates may be asked to provide references* **Why You’ll Want to Work with Aegis:** Aegis is an innovative, diverse, and dynamic company with tightly woven teams constantly exploring new ways to produce advantages for our clients. With offices in Virginia, Maryland, and Alabama, we provide opportunities to work in a variety of settings and use the collaborative brainpower around you to ask and answer interesting questions. You can expect to see the solutions you develop rapidly incorporated into our world class products and services that are critical to the global telecom industry. We have a broad range of backgrounds and interests: experts in fields such as finance, real estate, politics, naval engineering, law enforcement, and even professional equestrian sports come together to make an intriguing and educational work environment. We offer excellent benefits and competitive salaries. Find out more at www.aegismobile.com. Pay: $90,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Flexible schedule * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Referral program * Tuition reimbursement * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Columbia, MD 21046

jobs.title: Cloud Data Architect (Full-time Remote, NC Based)
jobs.description: The Cloud Data Architect is responsible for design and implementation of scalable enterprise\-wide data architecture. The Cloud Data Architect optimizes data performance and accessibility, and ensuring data quality, integrity and security. **This position is full\-time remote. Selected candidate must reside in North Carolina and be willing to travel to the home office (Morrisville, NC)** **for****onsite team meetings as needed.** **Responsibilities \& Duties** Data Architecture Design and Modelling * Lead adoption of modern data architecture patterns and cloud\-native solutions * Develop enterprise data management strategies including data lake/warehouse implementations, data movement, and data services * Enforce data quality, security, and consistency standards across enterprise data platforms * Establish data access patterns (serving layers, semantic models, APIs) to optimize downstream analytics and reporting * Participate in business analysis activities to elicit data product requirements Enterprise Data Platform Strategy * Lead adoption of modern data architecture patterns and cloud\-native solutions * Define future\-state data architecture roadmaps aligned to organizational strategy and modernization initiatives * Develop enterprise data management strategies including data lake/warehouse implementations, data movement, and data services * Enforce data quality, security, and consistency standards across enterprise data platforms Data Engineering Enablement * Define reference architectures, coding standards, and reusable patterns for data engineering teams * Review and approve solution designs to ensure adherence to enterprise data architecture standards * Provide technical mentorship and design guidance to engineers and analysts * Data Governance \& Security Participate in data governance council and provide input on data standards and policies to ensure data quality, security, and compliance * Collaborate with security and compliance teams to implement data classification, encryption, access controls, and audit logging * Ensure data architectures comply with HIPAA, and organizational data privacy standards Stakeholder Collaboration \& Communication * Capture end\-user requirements and align technical solutions to strategic business objectives * Translate business needs into scalable, secure, and well\-governed data architecture solutions * Provide architectural expertise and leadership guidance to data engineering teams **Minimum Requirements** Education \& Experience Required: Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field and at least five (5\) years of experience working as a Cloud Data Architect with direct involvement and responsibilities for architecting an enterprise\-scale data Lakehouse or data warehouse on a public, private or hybrid cloud platform, preferably in a healthcare setting. Microsoft Certified Databricks Data Engineer Professional or comparable technical certification is preferred at the time of hire and must be obtained within 12 months of employment if not already held. Preferred: Microsoft Certified Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ\-500\) or comparable technical certification is preferred. **Knowledge, Skills, \& Abilities** * Architecting enterprise\-scale multi\-layer data platform on a public, private, and hybrid cloud environment. * Designing, implementing, and administration of enterprise\-scale data and analytics platforms using modern cloud data platforms and distributed processing technologies. * Data modeling: dimensional (Kimball), star/snowflake, and SCDs. * Enterprise governance frameworks for data quality, lineage, and metadata. * PySpark and SQL skills for scalable batch and streaming pipelines. * Experience designing, implementing, and supporting cloud\-based data storage, integration, processing, and analytics platforms. * DevOps, Git and CI/CD best practices. * Architectural artifacts \& documentation (e.g., technical specs, data models, policies, procedures, architecture diagrams). * Agile methodology and tools. * HIPAA/HITECH compliance in cloud architectures. * Technical leadership skills. * Communication and organizational skills. * Ability to work independently and in a team setting. * Experience working with healthcare datasets. **Employment for this position is contingent upon a satisfactory background and credit check, which will be performed after acceptance of an offer of employment and prior to the employee's start date.** **Salary Range** $118\-$150,872/Annually **Exact compensation will be determined based on the candidate's education, experience, external market data and consideration of internal equity.** *An excellent fringe benefit package accompanies the salary, which includes:* * *Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Long Term Disability* * *Generous retirement savings plan* * *Flexible work schedules including hybrid/remote options* * *Paid time off including vacation, sick leave, holiday, management leave* * *Dress flexibility* #### **Education** Required* Bachelors or better in Computer Science * Bachelors or better in Other Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: DCO Tech
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Join our dynamic AWS team and become a critical guardian of global cloud infrastructure! You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of the world's most innovative technology platform, ensuring seamless data center operations that power millions of businesses and services worldwide. Data Center Technician position involves in\-depth hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair as well as participating in an on\-call rotation. AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H\-1B, TN, and other non\-immigrant visas, for this role. NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position. Key job responsibilities * Performing server rack installations, hardware break\-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues, responding to operational incidents that impact service availability, and carrying out routine network, server hardware, and operating system repairs to contribute to the overall availability of AWS services * Serving as a primary contact point for both internal and external stakeholders, including engineers, software developers, vendors, and contractors * Performing on\-call duties and participating in scheduled maintenance and change management activities * Contributing to documentation and process improvement initiatives based on your analysis of operational issues * Helping to interview, train and onboard new team members Physical Requirements: * Lifting and moving material up to 40 pounds each * Working in cramped and/or elevated locations * Bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching * Standing and walking for up to 8\+ hours a day * Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation Work in an industrial environment * Work shifts longer than 8 hours to support 24/7 operations (covering both night and day shifts). * This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational. Essential Requirements: * Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed * Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational * Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs. A day in the life Our Data Center Technician professionals, who have industry\-leading technical abilities and demonstrate a breadth of knowledge while they: * Take ownership of technical issues brought by their customer base, engaging other teams when needed to drive resolution * Show a strong aptitude for troubleshooting and problem solving * Solve problems at their root and step back to understand the broader context * Maintain service level agreements through the implementation of proactive issue detection and reporting * Are biased to act in the absence of direction or support * Improve effectiveness through process innovation You will be required to work shift work that will include days/nights/weekends/holidays. About the team Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion of events fosters stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do. Mentorship \& Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship, and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional. Work/Life Balance We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * Experience in computer networking * Experience with computer hardware troubleshooting and repair **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Can work in cramped spaces or in elevated locations while adhering to health \& safety guidelines * Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure * Experience managing work and priorities through a ticketing system * Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies * Experience working in a data center environment (racking and stacking gear, cable management, hot/cold aisle containment) Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign\-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life \& AD\&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits. USA, MD, Frederick \- 30\.91 \- 54\.18 USD hourly USA, OH, Columbus \- 30\.91 \- 54\.18 USD hourly USA, OH, Etna \- 30\.91 \- 54\.18 USD hourly USA, VA, Ashburn \- 30\.91 \- 54\.18 USD hourly USA, VA, Dulles \- 30\.91 \- 54\.18 USD hourly USA, VA, Fredericksburg \- 30\.91 \- 54\.18 USD hourly USA, VA, Haymarket \- 30\.91 \- 54\.18 USD hourly USA, VA, Herndon \- 30\.91 \- 54\.18 USD hourly USA, VA, Manassas \- 30\.91 \- 54\.18 USD hourly USA, VA, Sterling \- 30\.91 \- 54\.18 USD hourly

jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Are you excited about working on the platform that reimagines how Amazon builds services? Datapath Responder is a Tier\-1 hosting platform used by Detail Page, Search, AmazonAPI, and hundreds of other teams to run their business logic at Amazon scale. As part of the Builder Foundations organization — the core platform behind Amazon's eCommerce business — your work impacts millions of customers across Kindle, Prime, Instant Video, Fulfillment, Alexa, and Amazon's global shopping experience, at a scale few systems anywhere reach: tens of millions of transactions per second worldwide, spiking higher on Prime Day. Datapath is the next step of service\-oriented architecture. Developers write their logic and deploy it with standard Amazon tooling — and Datapath takes over, deciding how to run it optimally. stability analysis, viscoelastic behavior and melt fracture elimination * **Process Window Optimization:** Partner with plant engineering to establish tight process windows, optimize line speeds, material characterization data into strict plant process specifications **Technical Leadership, Code Compliance \& Alliances** * **Industry Standards \& Building Codes:** Ensure all new formulations jobs.title: Onboarding Program Manager
jobs.description: With over 140 years of innovation and service excellence, Burroughs keeps technology running for some of the largest financial institutions and retailers across North America. Through our North American network of field service professionals and digital support teams, we deliver full lifecycle management for payment and transaction automation, self\-service, robotic, and IoT technologies—ensuring our customers experience maximum uptime and performance every day. At Burroughs, we believe in growing our people as much as we grow our technology services. Many of our leaders began their careers in the field, and their success stories continue to inspire new generations of technicians, engineers, and support professionals. Our work is diverse, dynamic, challenging, and rewarding—but for those with curiosity, integrity, and a drive to learn, Burroughs is a place to build a lasting and meaningful career. Job Summary The Onboarding Program Manager is responsible for designing, building, and continuously improving a cohesive, unified, and repeatable onboarding program for Burroughs’ technical workforce. This role sits within the Training organization and plays a critical role in accelerating speed to competency and confidence for new hires supporting Burroughs\-serviced and installed products. This individual will leverage AI\-enabled learning technologies, content curation and data\-lake strategies, augmented reality (AR), and mentorship\-style shadowing models to modernize onboarding across field service, technical support, and product\-centric roles. The role blends instructional design, knowledge architecture, and emerging technology to ensure onboarding is scalable, measurable, and tightly aligned to operational outcomes. Essential Functions / Key Responsibilities * Design and own a standardized, role\-based onboarding framework that can be consistently deployed across products, regions, and technical roles. * Build structured onboarding journeys that blend digital learning, instructor\-led or virtual sessions, mentorship\-style shadowing, and hands\-on labs and simulations. * Ensure onboarding content progresses logically from foundational knowledge to job\-ready execution. Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities * AI\-Enabled Learning \& Knowledge Architecture * Leverage AI technologies to surface relevant onboarding content contextually, reduce time spent searching for technical information, and improve learner confidence during early field assignments. * Partner with relevant teams to aggregate technical content into a centralized, searchable knowledge data lake. * Apply metadata, tagging, and taxonomy standards to ensure content is discoverable and continuously usable. Content Curation \& Knowledge Consolidation * Identify and inventory all pockets of technical content across the organization. * Curate, normalize, and structure content into a single source of truth for onboarding and early\-tenure support. * Establish governance for content quality, ownership, and lifecycle management. Augmented Reality \& Experiential Learning * Incorporate augmented reality (AR) and immersive learning approaches to support equipment familiarity, installation workflows, and maintenance and troubleshooting procedures. * Collaborate with SMEs and vendors to align AR use cases to real\-world field scenarios. Mentor \& Shadowing Program Enablement * Design scalable mentorship\-style onboarding models that pair new hires with experienced technicians or specialists. * Create structured shadowing plans, observation checklists, and skill validation milestones. * Ensure consistency and quality across regions while allowing for local operational nuance. Measurement, Optimization \& Continuous Improvement * Define onboarding KPIs tied to operational outcomes such as time to first independent job, time to productivity, early\-tenure error rates or callbacks, and new\-hire confidence metrics. * Use data and feedback to continuously refine onboarding pathways and learning assets. Education \& Experience Preferred Qualifications * 2\-5 years' experience supporting field service, ATM, POS, smart safe, robotics, or unattended technology environments. * Familiarity with AR/VR learning platforms. * Experience with AI\-powered search or knowledge tools. * Background in instructional design models. * Experience aligning onboarding outcomes to service or customer performance metrics. Core Competencies * Systems thinking and learning architecture design. * Strong collaboration across technical and operational teams. * Ability to translate complex technical information into structured learning pathways. * Change leadership and influence without authority. * Data\-driven decision making and continuous improvement mindset. Physical Requirements \& Working Conditions * This is a largely sedentary role requiring use of typical office equipment such as a computer, laptop, and phone. * Office\-based position. Burroughs is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Drug Free Workplace. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status or disability.

jobs.title: Warehouse Associate - Hazardous/Industrial
jobs.description: **About the Role:** CBRE is hiring a Warehouse Associate on behalf of a leading global technology manufacturer in San Jose, CA! In this hands\-on role, you'll support the safe handling, labeling, storage, and shipment of materials, including hazardous materials, while ensuring compliance with shipping regulations and safety standards. From preparing shipments and maintaining inventory accuracy to loading and unloading freight and coordinating logistics activities, you'll play a critical role in keeping operations running efficiently. If you're detail\-oriented, safety\-focused, and thrive in a fast\-paced environment, this is an excellent opportunity to join a world\-class operation and make an immediate impact. This job is part of the Supply Chain function. They are responsible for maximizing the effectiveness of the organization’s supply chain. **What You’ll Do:** Prepare documents and shipping orders. Pack, seal, and label materials for shipping using the most cost\-effective method of shipping. Examine contents and compare with records to verify the accuracy of outgoing shipments. Record shipment data, such as weight, charges, space availability, and damages and discrepancies, for reporting, accounting, and record\-keeping purposes. Contact carrier representative to make arrangements and to issue instructions for shipping and delivery of materials. Requisition and store shipping materials and supplies to maintain inventory of stock. Keep records on the use and damage of stock or stock handling equipment. Work closely with customers, subcontractors, engineers, designers, project managers, sales, shipping and receiving and panel shop to help Operations facilitate on\-time and on\-budget projects. Gather and analyze data to identify and solve complex problems that arise with little or no precedent. May recommend new techniques. Impact own team and other teams whose work activities are closely related. Suggest improvements to existing processes and solutions to improve the efficiency of the team. What You’ll Need: High School Diploma or GED with 3\-4 years of job\-related experience. Physical requirements to include stooping, standing, climbing and frequent lifting of a minimum of 50 lbs. A comprehensive understanding of a range of processes, procedures, systems, and concepts within own job function is required. Ability to evaluate and communicates unusual and/or complex content in a concise and logical way. In\-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc. Advanced organizational skills with an inquisitive mindset. Advanced math skills. Ability to calculate advanced figures such as percentages, discounts, and markups Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future. Why CBRE? We are guided by the needs of the cities we inhabit, the communities we build and the world we thrive in! **Benefits start 1st of the month:** Medical, dental vision, PTO, 401k match, paid holidays and more... Internal advancement available after 6\-month mark **Work/Life Balance:** 40\-45 hours a week AI Use Disclosure We value human interaction to understand each candidate's unique experience, skills, and aspirations. We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to make hiring decisions, and we ask that candidates disclose any use of AI in the application and interview process. CBRE carefully considers multiple factors to determine compensation, including a candidate’s education, training, and experience. The minimum salary for the Warehouse Associate position is $25 per hour and the maximum salary is $30 per hour. The compensation that is offered to a successful candidate will depend on the candidate’s skills, qualifications, and experience. This role will provide the following benefits: 401(K), Dental insurance, Health insurance, Life insurance, and Vision insurance. **Equal Employment Opportunity:** CBRE is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity. We have a long\-standing commitment to providing equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, veteran status, political belief, or any other basis protected by applicable law. **Candidate Accommodations:** CBRE values the differences of all current and prospective employees and recognizes how every employee contributes to our company’s success. CBRE provides reasonable accommodations in job application procedures for individuals with disabilities. If you require assistance due to a disability in the application or recruitment process, please submit a request via email at recruitingaccommodations@cbre.com or via telephone at \+1 866 225 3099 (U.S.) and \+1 866 388 4346 (Canada).

jobs.title: Part Time RE Developer Assistant
jobs.description: **Header** **Overview** Join our dynamic team as a Part Time RE Developer Assistant, where you'll play a vital role in supporting real estate development projects through technical expertise and innovative system solutions. This position offers an exciting opportunity to collaborate with experienced developers and contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of scalable software systems. If you’re passionate about software engineering, eager to expand your skills in web and application development, and thrive in a fast\-paced environment, this role is perfect for you! We are committed to providing a paid position that fosters growth, learning, and meaningful contribution. **Duties** * Assist in designing and developing scalable web applications using Ruby on Rails, JavaScript frameworks, and RESTful APIs. * Support the implementation of cloud infrastructure solutions on platforms such as AWS to ensure system reliability and scalability. * Contribute to system design for system development projects, focusing on microservices architecture and design patterns. * Collaborate within Agile software development teams to plan sprints, review code, and deliver high\-quality features efficiently. * Help maintain version control repositories using GitHub, SVN, or similar tools; participate in CI/CD pipelines for seamless deployment. * Support front\-end development efforts utilizing JavaScript, React Express, and other modern frameworks to enhance user interfaces. * Assist with database management tasks involving SQL databases like MySQL and application development with Java, Python, or C\+\+ as needed. **Qualifications** * Basic understanding of IT infrastructure concepts including cloud infrastructure (AWS) and scalable systems design. * Experience or familiarity with Ruby on Rails, JavaScript frameworks (React, Angular), and RESTful API development. * Knowledge of software engineering principles such as design patterns, microservices architecture, and system design for scalability. * Proficiency in programming languages including JavaScript, Python, Java, C\+\+, or C; experience with front\-end development is a plus. * Experience with version control tools like Git or SVN; understanding of CI/CD practices for automated testing and deployment. * Strong problem\-solving skills coupled with the ability to work collaboratively within Agile teams. * Eagerness to learn new technologies such as quantum engineering concepts or advanced cloud infrastructure solutions is desirable but not mandatory. Embark on a rewarding journey supporting innovative real estate technology solutions! This paid part\-time role offers flexible hours while enabling you to develop valuable skills in software development, system design, and cloud infrastructure—perfect for aspiring developers eager to make an impact in a vibrant industry environment. Pay: $25\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour Expected hours: 12\.0 – 20\.0 per week Benefits: * Flexible schedule * Lunch \& learns * On\-the\-job training * Work from home Work Location: Hybrid remote in Kingston, NY 12401

jobs.title: Product Operations Manager
jobs.description: We are a leading trading platform ambitiously expanding across the global trading, investing and banking markets, and continuously entering new product categories and new geographies. Our award\-winning products combine advanced technology with an exceptional client experience. As we scale, our ability to operate with speed, consistency, and precision becomes critical. The Product Operations Manager plays a central role in enabling this \- driving operational excellence across product squads and ensuring our teams deliver high\-quality outcomes efficiently and consistently. **Purpose of the Role** The Product Operations Manager provides the operational backbone that keeps product squads moving at pace. A true generalist, this role spans strategy, delivery, data, and process \- no two days are the same. They drive momentum, solve problems, and remove obstacles so teams can deliver quickly, effectively, and at consistently high standards. By streamlining delivery processes, maintaining governance and documentation discipline, and ensuring alignment across teams, they enable Product Owners to focus on strategic priorities while safeguarding execution quality. The role is hands\-on and adaptive \- anticipating issues, connecting dots across teams, and ensuring progress continues from concept through to launch and beyond. ### **Responsibilities:** * Drive operational excellence across product squads by optimizing delivery processes, governance, and documentation. * Coordinate with card scheme/issuing partner (payment provider). * Ensure new product initiatives and platform changes are well\-defined, compliant, and launch\-ready through structured business cases and approval processes. * Act as a delivery enabler \- removing blockers, coordinating stakeholders, and maintaining the documentation and data foundations needed for rapid, high\-quality execution. * Partner with Product Owners, Engineers, and Data Analysts to ensure reliable metrics, dashboards, and insights guide decision\-making and prioritisation. * Track performance post\-launch, monitor product stability and adoption, and facilitate continuous improvement through structured feedback loops. * Lead planning and operational cadences (KPIs, stand ups, retrospectives), maintaining momentum and alignment across teams. * Identify and implement process improvements that enhance delivery speed, quality, and scalability. * Drive product strategy by translating operational insights, customer feedback, and market intelligence into future features direction, ensuring delivery execution aligns with strategic priorities and the long\-term product vision. ### **Requirements:** * Degree in STEM or other quantitative fields. * Minimum 2 years experience in a high performance environment (fintech, consultancy, investment bank, high\-growth tech company, etc.). * Minimum 2 years of experience working with debit cards and payments (SWIFT, SEPA, Faster Payments). * Experience working with card schemes (Visa, Mastercard). * Ability to solve complex problems independently. * Deep empathy for customers and commitment to user\-centred design without compromise. * Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, capable of influencing across functions. * Data\-driven mindset, able to turn insights into actionable improvements. * Strong ownership mentality – proactive, accountable, and execution\-focused approach. ### **Nice to have:** * Experience building or scaling successful products \- particularly financial or data\-driven \- using analytics, customer feedback, and pragmatic judgment. * Experience with compliance regulations for card products (onboarding, notifications, restrictions). * Experience with fraud monitoring for card transactions. **What you will get in return:** * Competitive Salary: We believe great work deserves great pay! Your skills and talents will be rewarded with a salary that makes you feel valued and motivated. * Work\-Life Harmony: Join a company that genuinely cares about you \-because your life outside of work matters just as much as your time on the clock. * Generous Time Off: Need a breather? Our annual leave policy lets you recharge and enjoy life outside of work without a worry. * Employee Referral Program: Love working here? Share the love! Bring your talented friends on board and get rewarded for growing our awesome team. * Comprehensive Health Benefits: We’ve got your back with a medical insurance plan. Plus, location\-specific benefits and perks! * Workation Wonderland: Live your digital nomad dreams with 30 extra days to work remotely from anywhere in the world (some restrictions apply). Adventure awaits! * Volunteer Days: Make a difference! Take two additional paid days each year to support causes you care about and give back to the community. Be a key player at the forefront of the digital assets movement, propelling your career to new heights! Join a dynamic and rapidly expanding company that values and rewards talent, initiative, and creativity. Work alongside one of the most brilliant teams in the industry. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Medical Receptionist
jobs.description: As a physician\-founded and led organization, ensuring everyone has access to quality healthcare is what inspires us. Experience with carrier\-class microwave radio systems, fiber optic transport, IP routing, Ethernet transport, MPLS, or operational technology networking is highly desirable. Familiarity with Aviat IRU600 microwave systems, Nokia 7705 SAR platforms, or other carrier\-grade communications platforms is a plus, but not required. If you have experience with similar technologies and a strong technical background, we encourage you to apply! **Job Description** ------------------- **Summary** Electronics Technician II personnel support the operation, reliability, and continuous improvement of Chugach’s telecommunications infrastructure, which forms the backbone of system operations, SCADA, substation, and generation communications, AMI field networks, land mobile radio, and enterprise voice and data services. Technicians in this role perform advanced installation, configuration, troubleshooting, and maintenance of microwave transport, fiber optic systems, RF networks, IP networking and MPLS platforms, digital telephony, backup power systems, and site security technologies used throughout the utility. Electronics Technician II personnel also contribute to system design, documentation quality, vendor coordination, and mentoring of developing technicians, supporting both operational continuity and Chugach’s long term technology objectives. **Reporting Relationship** * Reports to: Manager Telecommunications. * Directs: Electronics Technician II may be required to direct the work of lower classifications. **Essential Functions** * Maintain competency in testing, maintenance, and safety practices through training, study of manuals, and hands\-on application. * Observe safe work practices in performance of daily work, including work at heights and in adverse weather conditions. * Assist in design, testing, and installation of new telecom equipment as assigned. * Analyze and interpret AC and DC diagrams, interconnect drawings, and schematics before starting work. * Prepare, update, and maintain drawings, records of inventory data, installation and commissioning test results, as\-builts and other relevant documentation as work is completed. * Use computers and diagnostic software to test, configure, and maintain communications. * Ensure compliance with applicable codes and standards including FCC rules, NESC, OSHA, and manufacturer specifications. * Support inter\-utility coordination for shared telecommunications facilities, circuits, and system restoration. * Installs and maintains Wide Area Network (WAN) equipment including hubs, switches, routers, term servers, and other IP devices in support of SCADA and telecommunications networks at generation plants, substations, and communications sites exclusive of the work performed by the SCADA/EMS Systems Engineer**,** Systems Analyst\-SCADA/EMS, and the Relay Department already being performed. * Configure, operate, troubleshoot, calibrate, and maintain all types of advanced telecommunication systems, including: + Digital microwave including multiplexers, ch ead color\-coded components and cables. * Must be able to lift 60 lbs. to waist height. * Ability to climb and work at heights of up to two hundred feet. Other Requirements * Valid Alaska Driver License * FCC General Radiotelephone Radio's license at hire or obtained by the end of probationary period. * Must maintain a residence, by the end of the probationary period, which permits a Sixty (60\) minute report time to the Chugach Dispatch Center. * Willing to spend approximately twenty percent (20%) of working time out of town * Availability for call outs for department needs outside of normal work hours. * Carry a company provided cellular phone while on duty or on standby. * Must obtain and maintain certification in tower climbing and rescue, fall protection, and related safety programs. **Work Conditions** Work will be performed in the field in varying weather conditions. Flights in fixed\-wing aircraft and helicopters will be required. Work will include working with helicopters slinging communications equipment to remote sites. Occasional exposure to cold temperatures for extended periods of time may be necessary. **Company Description** ----------------------- Chugach Electric Association is a member\-owned cooperative, headquartered in Anchorage, Alaska's largest city. Anchorage itself sits at the base of the Chugach Mountains. Chugach is pleased to provide reliable, affordable power to more than 92,000 members from Anchorage to the northern Kenai Peninsula, and from Whittier on Prince William Sound to Tyonek on the west side of Cook Inlet. We service over 113,000 locations with 3,782 miles of transmission and distribution lines. We have many services that make it easy to power homes and businesses with Chugach. A little more about us: Chugach has been around for a long time, recently celebrating 75 years! We are a stable company, in a stable industry. And while we may have stability, we are modern, sustainable and forward\-thinking to ensure that we provide reliable services for generations to come. We also pride ourselves on the longevity of our employees. We have several 20, 30 and 40 \+ year tenured employees who continue foster an inclusive, innovative corporate environment. The position plays a critical role in ensuring that technology systems supporting students, teachers, administrators, and district operations are reliable, secure, scalable, and available across all Pawtucket School Department facilities. The Systems Engineer will be responsible for supporting a diverse district technology environment that includes Windows and Linux servers, virtualization, Layer 3 switching and routing, network infrastructure, Apple devices and management platforms, storage, cloud services, Google Workspace, identity and access management, cybersecurity systems, backups, endpoint management, telecommunications, and other enterprise applications. The candidate must also be able to communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical staff. Cloud \& Enterprise Systems ●Administer and support district cloud\-based services and enterprise technology platforms. ●Support the administration of Google Workspace for Education, including user accounts, organizational units, groups, authentication, security policies, and administrative settings. ●Assist with the implementation and management of cloud applications and services. ●Evaluate new technologies and services for compatibility, security, cost effectiveness, and district needs. ●Assist in integrating cloud\-based applications with existing district systems. ●Monitor cloud services and resolve authentication, connectivity, synchronization, and integration issues. Cybersecurity ●Assist in developing, implementing, and maintaining the School Department's cybersecurity infrastructure. ●Monitor systems for suspicious activity, vulnerabilities, and potential security incidents. ●Implement security updates, patches, configuration changes, and other remediation measures. ●Assist with vulnerability management and security assessments. ●Support endpoint security, email security, authentication security, and network security systems. ●Investigate and respond to cybersecurity incidents in coordination with the Technology Department. ●Assist in maintaining district security standards and procedures. ●Participate in phishing prevention, security awareness, and other cybersecurity initiatives. ●Stay current on emerging cybersecurity threats and recommended security practices affecting K–12 educational environments. Security \& Confidentiality: The Systems Engineer will have access to systems and information that may contain confidential student, employee, financial, and operational information. The employee must: ●Maintain strict confidentiality of district information. ●Follow all applicable federal, state, and local laws, regulations, and district policies. ●Follow established cybersecurity and acceptable\-use practices. ●Maintain appropriate security controls for systems under their responsibility. ●Immediately report suspected security incidents or unauthorized access. ●Follow district procedures regarding privileged administrative access. Physical Requirements: The position may require: ●Working at a computer for extended periods. ●Moving between district schools and administrative facilities. ●Working in server rooms, wiring closets, and other technology spaces. ●Occasionally lifting and moving technology equipment weighing up to \[insert weight] pounds. ●Standing, walking, bending, reaching, and working in confined spaces as necessary. ●Occasional work outside of normal business hours for system maintenance, upgrades, migrations, emergency response, or scheduled technology projects. ●May have to lift or carry up to 50 lbs. Work Schedule: This is a 12\-month, full\-time position. The Systems Engineer may be required to work outside of normal business hours, including evenings, weekends, or school vacations, when necessary to perform: ●Server maintenance ●Infrastructure upgrades ●System migrations ●Security updates ●Network maintenance ●Disaster recovery testing ●Major technology deployments ●Emergency system restoration Advance notice will be provided whenever reasonably possible. Performance Expectations: The Systems Engineer is expected to: 1\.Maintain reliable and secure technology infrastructure throughout the district. 2\.Respond promptly and professionally to critical technology incidents. 3\.Proactively identify system weaknesses and recommend improvements. 4\.Maintain accurate technical documentation. 5\.Protect district information and technology assets. 6\.Successfully implement assigned technology projects. 7\.Collaborate effectively with other members of the Technology Department. 8\.Provide excellent service to schools and district staff. 9\.Continuously improve the efficiency, security, and reliability of district technology systems. 10\.Support the Technology Department's mission of providing secure, reliable, and innovative technology services that support student learning and district operations. Pay: $90,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Retirement plan Work Location: In person

DENTAL, VISION, LIFE AND DISABILITY INSURANCES. applications developed by the team * Collaborate with internal stakeholders to scope and deliver new data integration projects * Contribute to the evaluation of modern data tooling options as we jobs.title: Engineering Manager - AutoReview
jobs.description: ### **About CoLab** At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life\-changing products to market years sooner. We build AI for engineers designing cars, medical devices, and jet engines. Products this complex aren't sketched and sent to production. Teams spend months on iterations, reviews, and tests, predicting how every part performs before anything is built. CoLab is where those reviews happen, and we capture the rationale behind every change. Other tools show what changed between versions. Only CoLab knows why. That's how our AI helps manufacturers like Bobcat, Triumph Motorcycles, and GE Appliances make better decisions, eliminate rework cycles, and get to market faster. Proudly based in St. John's, Newfoundland, CoLab started with one customer in 2018\. Since then we've raised a $72M Series C, been named the 57th fastest growing company in North America by Deloitte (Fast 500™), signed multi\-year AI partnerships with companies like Bombardier, and grown to a team of 250\+. ### **About the Role** We're hiring an Engineering Manager to lead the team building AutoReview—CoLab's AI\-powered capabilities for automating mechanical design review. This is a people leadership role that requires real technical depth. You won't need to be the engineer writing every solution, but you should understand software and web architecture well enough to pressure\-test an approach, spot when an estimate doesn't add up, and ask the question that changes the conversation. You'll work closely with Product to turn broad ideas into a roadmap the team can confidently execute. That includes making early calls on feasibility and scope, then giving engineers the context and autonomy to work through the details. The technical problems are substantial: DFM checks, clash detection, BOM consolidation, clearance analysis, bulk AutoReview workflows, and increasingly, the intersection of 2D engineering data and machine learning. ### **Our Ideal Candidate** * You've managed engineers working on technically complex web applications—ideally involving geometry, 3D data, geometric processing, CAD, graphics, or adjacent domains. * You care deeply about people and understand the technology they're building. You stay connected enough to the work to identify risks early without becoming the person everyone depends on for every decision. * This team is smart, motivated, and eager to move. Your job isn't to manufacture ambition; it's to provide clarity so that ambition is focused on the right problems. * You'll also help establish clearer, respectful boundaries between Engineering and Product ownership. If you enjoy building that kind of trusting partnership while navigating ambiguity, you'll do well here. ### **Job Responsibilities** * Lead, coach, and support the engineers responsible for Build AutoReview. * Partner closely with Product to define priorities, assess feasibility, roughly scope initiatives, and build realistic timelines. * Maintain enough technical context across projects to surface risks, dependencies, and questionable assumptions early. * Help the team deliver major AutoReview initiatives, including DFM checks, assembly analysis, and bulk review workflows. * Work across Engineering, Product, and the applied ML Team as AutoReview expands into areas where ownership and technical approaches are still evolving. * Create focus when priorities change quickly because of new customer insight, technical developments, or advances in AI and ML. * Build an environment where engineers have clear context, meaningful ownership, and the support to do excellent work. ### **Qualifications** * Experience managing software engineers in a technically complex product domain. * Strong technical foundation in modern web application and software architecture. * Experience with geometric processing, 3D/CAD applications, graphics, or similar technical systems is a strong asset. * Demonstrated ability to partner with Product on roadmap planning, technical feasibility, estimation, and prioritization. * Comfortable navigating evolving AI/ML technologies and understanding how they affect product and architecture decisions. * Able to move quickly through new information, make thoughtful decisions, and communicate tradeoffs clearly. ### **Extra Details** This is a full\-time, permanent position with a competitive compensation package that includes stock options. We offer comprehensive benefits and flexible vacation. **This is a remote position open in Canada and the US.** ### **Equity Note** Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic and apply even if you don't meet every single qualification—your potential is what matters most to us.

jobs.title: Director/Managing Director, AI Software Development
jobs.description: Opportunity ID 10034 Department Practice Management Location(s) Denver State Colorado Function GenAI Job Description As CohnReznick grows, so do our career opportunities. As one of the nation’s top professional services firms, CohnReznick creates rewarding careers in advisory, assurance, and tax with team members who value innovation and collaboration in everything they do! CohnReznick helps organizations optimize performance, manage risk, and maximize value through CohnReznick LLP (assurance services) and CohnReznick Advisory LLC (advisory and tax services). Together, the firm provides leaders with deep industry knowledge and relationships, solutions to address clients’ unique business goals and risks, and insight on how emerging market forces can drive opportunity. With offices nationwide, the firm serves organizations around the world as an independent member of Nexia. We currently have an exciting career opportunity for a **Director/Managing Director, AI Software Development** to support our **Global Digital \& CyberSecurity** practice. CohnReznick is a hybrid firm and most of our professionals are located within a commutable distance to one of our offices. This position is considered remote which means it does not require job duties be performed within proximity of a CohnReznick office location. However, as a remote employee, you may be required to be present at a CohnReznick office with scheduled notice for client work, team meetings, or trainings. **YOUR TEAM.** The Director / Managing Director, AI Software Development is a senior technology leader responsible for establishing and leading CohnReznick's software engineering capability. This position defines the vision, strategy, operating model, talent plan, architecture, and delivery approach for AI\-enabled products, platforms, and solutions across the firm. The position is accountable for building a high\-performing AI\-native software development organization capable of delivering proprietary technology assets that create sustainable competitive advantage. The leader oversees the design, development, deployment, and operation of AI\-powered applications, intelligent automation solutions, agentic workflows, and client\-facing digital products. This is not a traditional application\-development leadership role. The successful candidate must have personally built and scaled a native AI software team from inception through production delivery, including recruiting specialized talent, establishing engineering and governance standards, and delivering secure applications with measurable business impact. **WHY COHNREZNICK?** At CohnReznick, we’re united by a common mission to create opportunity, value, and trust for our clients, our people, and our communities. Whether it’s working alongside your peers to solve a client challenge, or volunteering together at the local food bank, there are so many ways to find your “why” at the firm. We believe it’s important to balance work with everyday life – and make time for enjoyment and fun. We invest in a robust Total Rewards package that includes everything from generous PTO, a flexible work environment, expanded parental leave, extensive learning \& development, and even paid time off for employees to volunteer. **YOUR ROLE.** ***Responsibilities include but not limited to:*** **AI strategy and portfolio leadership** * Define and execute a multi\-year AI software engineering strategy aligned with firm business and technology objectives. * Establish the vision, roadmap, investment priorities, and operating model for the GDC AI development capability. * Identify opportunities to create proprietary software assets that improve client service, quality, efficiency, growth, and professional experience. * Advise executive leaders and governance forums on opportunities, investments, risks, dependencies, and portfolio performance. **Native AI organization building** * Recruit, organize, develop, and retain a multidisciplinary team of AI engineers, software engineers, machine learning engineers, technical leads, and architects. * Define job architecture, role expectations, career paths, leadership spans, technical communities, and talent\-development practices for the AI engineering function. * Create an engineering culture centered on innovation, responsible experimentation, accountability, inclusion, collaboration, and disciplined production delivery. * Build a sustainable talent pipeline and develop future engineering leaders. **Product and solution delivery** * Lead AI\-enabled products, platforms, and solutions from discovery and architecture through engineering, release, adoption, operation, and continuous improvement. * Partner with Product Management and business stakeholders to translate strategic priorities into sequenced, funded, and measurable delivery commitments. * Manage execution across concurrent initiatives while balancing value, speed, quality, security, risk, reliability, and maintainability. * Establis asurable outcomes, iterative development, user feedback, adoption measures, and value realization. **Preferred Qualifications** * Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Business, or a related field. * Leadership experience in professional services, financial services, regulated industries, or enterprise B2B software. * Experience with Microsoft Azure AI, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot technologies, and modern AI engineering frameworks. * Relevant credentials in AI, cloud architecture, software engineering, cybersecurity, or product delivery. * Experience commercializing proprietary software or creating client\-facing digital products and technology\-enabled services. In addition, please take a moment to review our **Universal Job Standards.** Studies have shown that we are less likely to apply to jobs unless we meet every single qualification. At CohnReznick, we are dedicated to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or one of our other roles. In **Colorado**, the salary range for a **Director, AI Software Development** is $192,000 to $264,000\. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, qualifications and location, and applicable employment laws. Salary is one component of the CohnReznick total rewards package, which includes a discretionary performance bonus, generous paid time off, expanded and inclusive parental benefits, and access to best\-in\-class learning and development platforms, to name a few. To learn more about life at CohnReznick, visit**Life at CohnReznick** "CohnReznick" is the brand name under which CohnReznick LLP and CohnReznick Advisory LLC and their respective subsidiaries provide professional services. CohnReznick LLP and CohnReznick Advisory LLC (and their respective subsidiaries) practice in an alternative practice structure in accordance with the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct and applicable law, regulations, and professional standards. CohnReznick LLP is a licensed CPA firm that provides attest services to its clients. CohnReznick Advisory LLC provides tax and business consulting services to its clients. CohnReznick Advisory LLC and its subsidiaries are not licensed CPA firms. CohnReznick is an equal opportunity employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive team to drive business results and create a better future every day for our team members, clients, partners, and communities. We believe a diverse workforce allows us to match our growth ambitions and drive inclusion across the business. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability. For more information, please see **Equal Employment Opportunity Posters.** If you are an individual with a disability in need of assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please contact us at**CRaccommodation@CohnReznick.com**Please note: This email address is reserved for individuals with disabilities in need of assistance and are not a means of inquiry about positions or application statuses. CohnReznick does not accept unsolicited resumes from third\-party recruiters unless such recruiters are currently engaged by CohnReznick Talent Acquisition Team by way of a written agreement to provide candidates for a specified opening. Any employment agency, person or entity that submits an unsolicited resume does so with the understanding that CohnReznick will have the right to hire that applicant at its discretion without any fee owed to the submitting employment agency, person or entity. \#GD \#LI\-WC1 \#IND123 (PMT)

The area is home to several growing communities with restaurants, festivals, shopping, and arts scenes that make them exciting places to live and work. **About Our Location** Our newly renovated Sidney campus has 1M square feet of manufacturing floor with an additional 120k square feet of leading\-edge lab facilities. jobs.title: Low Voltage Estimator – Div 27/28 Security & Cabling – Fort Lauderdale
jobs.description: Low Voltage Estimator – Full Scope Division 27/28 Fort Lauderdale, FL \| Full\-time \| On\-site Why this role exists Coranet needs an estimator who can own complete commercial low\-voltage bid packages\-from drawing review and takeoff through pricing, proposal, and post\-award turnover. You'll work directly with sales, vendors, and project managers to deliver accurate, clearly scoped bids on time. This is a hands\-on estimating role. You should be comfortable identifying missing information, developing documented assumptions, coordinating specialty\-system pricing, and moving a bid forward without waiting for a perfect set of documents. About Coranet Coranet is a national low\-voltage integrator \- structured cabling (Div. 27\), physical security and access control (Div. 28\), wireless/DAS, and AV. We work with developers and general contractors on ground\-up new construction, major renovations, and enterprise environments across Florida, the Southeast, Mid\-Atlantic, Northeast, and Texas. Inc. 5000 for four years running. Certified Women\-Owned Small Business. What you'll own Complete bid packages: Review plans, specifications, addenda, schedules, and bid requirements. Own the consolidated low\-voltage scope, including interfaces between systems and other trades Takeoffs in Bluebeam Revu. Drawings, specs, addenda, symbol sets, toolsets, revisions. This is where you'll live. Detailed and accurate with part numbers and counts. Estimates in simPRO. Labor, material, assemblies, job\-costing inputs. If you haven't used simPRO, we'll teach you \- it's learnable in weeks if you already think like an estimator. Full Div. 27/28 scope: structured cabling, fiber, pathway and support, racks and cabinets, CCTV, access control, intrusion, wireless, AV, BDA, and related systems. Scope gaps and bid risks. Find what's missing or contradictory in the documents, write the RFIs and clarifications, propose the fix. Nobody hands you a clean set. Proposals and bid reviews: Clean, defensible scope language \- inclusions, exclusions, assumptions, alternates, value engineering. Vendor and manufacturer pricing. Solicit, level, and validate distributor and sub quotes. Push for better numbers. Post\-award support: Cut sheets, product data, and a clean turnover to PM: scope, assumptions, labor plan, procurement notes. You stay with the job past the win. Bid pipeline. Track what's out, follow up, flag risk, keep award probability honest. Customer support and sales pitches: support sales technically on customer pitches as needed You'll work shoulder to shoulder with sales \- in on pitches and bid reviews as the technical voice in the room. What you'll bring Experience independently estimating commercial low\-voltage projects, including takeoffs, labor and material pricing, vendor coordination, and proposal preparation. Strong working knowledge of structured cabling, access control and physical security, with the ability to coordinate pricing for other systems within a complete package. Strong Bluebeam Revu skills or demonstrated proficiency with comparable takeoff software. The ability to read and reconcile plans, specifications, schedules, risers, and addenda. Sound judgment about what is included, what is missing, and when an assumption needs review. Reliable deadline management and the ability to handle multiple bids. Availability to work daily in our Fort Lauderdale office. Nice to have \- we'll train the rest simPRO, or another estimating/ops platform (Accubid, McCormick, ConEst, D\-Tools). Access control and VMS platforms: LenelS2, Genetec, Software House, AMAG, HID, Avigilon, Milestone, Verkada, Brivo, Openpath. Light engineering instinct: device placement logic, system architecture, riser and schematic coordination. AV, BMS, lighting control, or DAS exposure. BICSI, RCDD, or manufacturer certifications. Associate's degree or trade/technical training a plus, not required. Your first 90 days Weeks 1–2: Learn our assemblies, labor units, and proposal standards. Shadow live bids. Produce your first quote. Weeks 3–6: Own small\-to\-mid bids independently, start to finish. By day 90: Carrying full ground\-up new construction packages with minimal review, and running your own submittals. What we offer Competitive salary depending on experience, plus performance bonus tied to what you bid and win. Full benefits: healthcare, dental, vision, 401(k), PTO, paid holidays. A team that trains in person. You will not be left to figure out a system you've never estimated on your own. Direct access to leadership and real influence over how we bid. Small enough that your judgment matters, big enough to chase serious work. Keywords: Low Voltage Estimator, Low Voltage Engineer, Division 27, Division 28, Structured Cabling Estimator, Security Estimator, Access Control, CCTV, Bluebeam Revu, simPRO, Takeoff, Bid Leveling, Commercial Construction, Fort Lauderdale, Broward, Miami, Palm Beach Pay: $70,000\.00 \- $90,000\.00 per year

Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you. **About the Role:** You'll be joining our macOS Endpoint Product team supporting CrowdStrike's flagship Falcon endpoint protection platform. This team is responsible for core sensor components in user space (Swift, C\+\+, ObjC\+\+). We build and maintain the macOS sensor, creating and building a platform for products and features that empower customers with prevention, detection, and response capabilities. **Location:** This role is hybrid, requiring 2\-3 days per week on\-site at one of the posted locations. **About the Team:** CrowdStrike Falcon Host is a two\-component security product. One component is a “sensor”: a driver installed on client machines that observes system activity and recognizes malicious behavior, then provides on\-box prevention capability and remote telemetry to the Falcon Host cloud. The sensor processes thousands of events per second to provide deep visibility into operations on the endpoint, and performs rich correlation and computation to identify malicious events and blocks malicious activity. The cloud component aggregates sensor telemetry for each customer’s network, correlates malicious behavior across multiple machines, and presents our customers’ operations teams with a prioritized summary of the threats detected in their environments.
