jobs.description: **About DealerOn** We are an online marketing company providing website and agency services to automotive dealerships across North and South America. We are known for our cutting\-edge products that streamline the car buying process and provide an experience both shoppers and dealers love. Our business model is working: we were recognized on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest growing companies six years in a row, expanding to over 30 manufacturer relationship, and over 5,000 dealer partners. We are proud of what our company has done, and it’s all due to the talented and diverse team we’ve been lucky enough to assemble. **Job Description:** The Senior Salesforce Developer is responsible for the administration, configuration, customization, and ongoing development of DealerOn's Salesforce platform. This role combines hands\-on Salesforce administration with custom application development to deliver scalable business solutions across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Revenue Cloud, Marketing Cloud Account Engagement (Pardot), and other integrated technologies. Working closely with business stakeholders, technical teams, and cross\-functional leaders, the Senior Salesforce Developer serves as a technical leader and subject matter expert responsible for evaluating business processes, architecting and recommending scalable technical solutions, configuring declarative functionality, developing custom applications and integrations, and ensuring the Salesforce platform remains secure, performant, and maintainable. The Developer translates complex business requirements into thoughtful, sustainable technical solutions and provides technical guidance throughout the solution lifecycle, from discovery and design through development, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization. The Senior Salesforce Developer partners across departments to identify opportunities to improve processes, leverage Salesforce capabilities, and drive operational efficiency. This role requires sound technical judgment in determining when to utilize declarative functionality versus custom development, with a strong focus on scalability, reusability, system architecture, data integrity, security, and minimizing technical debt. The Developer also contributes to platform governance, development standards, solution design, and the continued evolution of the Salesforce ecosystem to support current and future business needs. This is a senior\-level remote position requiring a high degree of autonomy, technical expertise, business acumen, and cross\-functional collaboration. **Essential Functions:** **Administration** * Serve as a Salesforce Administrator responsible for the day\-to\-day health, maintenance, and optimization of the Salesforce platform. * Configure and maintain objects, fields, page layouts, record types, validation rules, flows, permission sets, profiles, sharing rules, queues, public groups, and custom metadata. * Manage user provisioning, deprovisioning, role hierarchy, permissions, and security while ensuring compliance with company policies. * Troubleshoot user issues, investigate system errors, and provide timely resolution for Salesforce\-related support requests. * Monitor Salesforce platform health, storage, integrations, and overall system performance. * Create and maintain reports, dashboards, and analytics to support business decision\-making. * Evaluate new Salesforce releases and recommend features that improve business processes. * Maintain platform documentation including configuration changes, system architecture, and administrative procedures. **Development** * Serve as the technical lead for complex Salesforce projects and enhancements, including breaking requirements into technical work, estimating development effort, identifying dependencies, coordinating development activities, and proactively addressing technical risks and blockers. * Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, SOQL, APIs, and other Salesforce technologies. * Build custom applications utilizing Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and Revenue Cloud/CPQ. * Develop, manage and maintain the Salesforce code repository, development lifecycle, and version control process, including organizing and maintaining source code and metadata, building branching and merging strategies, supporting code reviews, resolving merge conflicts, and ensuring changes are properly documented, tested, and promoted across Salesforce environments. * Serve as a technical authority and escalation point for complex Salesforce development, architecture, integration, performance, and security issues. * Make recommendations and technical decisions regarding development approaches, platform architecture, tools, integrations, and technology adoption. * Utilize JavaScript, HTML5, CSS, Web Services, and Salesforce APIs to develop and enhance business applications. * Investigate and resolve compl  * Provide technical leadership and guidance to Salesforce administrators, developers, and other technical team members. * Establish and promote development standards, coding conventions, design patterns, and engineering best practices across the Salesforce environment. * Mentor and develop technical team members by providing guidance on architecture, solution design, development practices, troubleshooting, and technical decision\-making. * Identify legacy code, inefficient automation, outdated development patterns, and architectural limitations. Develop and prioritize remediation strategies to improve the long\-term health, maintainability, and scalability of the Salesforce platform. * Produce and maintain technical documentation for custom solutions and integrations. * Facilitate the testing and implementation of Salesforce and JIRA tools. Includes coding, configuration, maintenance, installation, testing, and debugging, as well as managing timelines **Required Experience** * A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Management Information Systems, or related field or equivalent experience. * Certifications as a Salesforce Platform Developer I and Salesforce Administrator. * 7\+ years of hands\-on Salesforce development experience, with demonstrated experience designing and delivering complex enterprise Salesforce solutions. * Demonstrated experience owning technical architecture and solution design for complex Salesforce implementations or major initiatives. * Demonstrated experience making technical recommendations and decisions that balance business requirements, platform capabilities, scalability, security, maintainability, and technical debt. * Experience leading development standards, code reviews, deployment practices, and technical governance within a Salesforce environment. * Experience designing and managing integrations between Salesforce and multiple external systems. * Experience mentoring developers and administrators and providing technical leadership within a collaborative team environment. * Ability to independently lead complex technical initiatives from discovery and solution design through development, deployment, and post\-production optimization. * Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, including data architecture, security model, sharing, automation, integration patterns, governor limits, platform limits, and performance considerations. * Ability to evaluate competing technical approaches and clearly articulate recommendations, tradeoffs, risks, and long\-term implications to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. \#LI\-Remote **This position is open to US residents only.** **The targeted salary range for this position is $95,700 \- $144,200\.** The posted salary range for this position may be adjusted based on job\-related factors permitted by law, such as experience and training; internal pay equity; licensure and certifications; market factors; departmental budgets; and responsibility. Our Talent Acquisition Team will be happy to answer any questions. **Perks and Benefits:** Aside from the awesome people you will get to interact with on a daily basis, we offer a number of benefits, including: * Medical, dental and vision insurance * Company matched 401K plan * Flexible PTO \+ Sick Leave * 6 weeks paid Parental Leave * 8 Paid National Holidays * Company\-paid basic Life Insurance * Voluntary supplemental Life Insurance * Voluntary long\-term/short\-term disability insurance * Voluntary Pet Insurance * Optional Healthcare/Dependent Care FSA Account DealerOn is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.title: Research Engineer, Tech Lead Manager, Frontier and AGI Security, DeepMind
jobs.description: Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **San Francisco, CA, USA; Mountain View, CA, USA; New York, NY, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * PhD degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5 years of experience in cybersecurity (e.g., red teaming, vulnerability identification, reverse engineering, black\-box evaluation, etc.). * 5 years of experience developing agentic tools. * 2 years of experience as a people manager. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * 2 years of experience in software development or engineering. * Track record of research or engineering achievements, such as publications in peer\-reviewed conferences or journals. * Passion for AI technology and all of its possibilities. **About the job** ----------------- At Google, research\-focused Software Engineers are embedded throughout the company, allowing them to setup large\-scale tests and deploy promising ideas quickly and broadly. Ideas may come from internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world. From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing new architectures, engineers work on real\-world problems including artificial intelligence, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and much more. But you stay connected to your research roots as an active contributor to the wider research community by partnering with universities and publishing papers. In this role, you will build solutions that enable us to protect the world from misuse of the next generation of frontier models and help defend against emerging cyber security risks. Capable cybersecurity models, combined with a sophisticated harness, you will present ongoing challenges that require better defenses. You will apply engineering, ML, RL, and cybersecurity knowledge to make software more secure, building both research prototypes and robust, scalable infrastructure. You will be a member of the cyberattack safety team, which is currently developing defenses for preventing misuse of our models for cyberattack as well as contributing to increasing Gemini’s capabilities for cyber defense. Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high\-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority. We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $207000 \- $300000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Improve our adversarial evaluation (auto\-red teaming) techniques. * Drive improvements for out\-of\-model defenses such as classifiers and introspection probes. * Collaborate with safety engineering to develop new capabilities based on adversarial research. * Contribute to increasing Gemini’s capabilities for cyber defense. * Gain an understanding of the path from research to production while working on real world problems. Your work will directly impact Gemini releases and users. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: AI Product Manager
jobs.description: At Didero, we’re building the autonomous supply chain, starting with agentic supplier management. Global trade has never been more complex or more critical. Teams are underwater, reacting to a flood of challenges — from geopolitical risk to tariffs. Didero helps by automating time\-intensive workflows with AI agents, deploying cutting\-edge technology into one of the world’s most vital domains. We’re backed by some of the world’s best venture funds and leading figures across AI, supply chain, and enterprise software. As an AI Product Manager, you'll help customers transform how procurement teams work by deploying AI agents into real\-world operations. You’ll own a portfolio of customer accounts, partnering directly with stakeholders to map their workflows, design implementation plans, and guide deployments from kickoff through long\-term success. The role sits at the intersection of product, strategy, operations, AI, and customer deployment. This is not a traditional product management role where you define requirements and hand them off to Engineering. It’s hands\-on, technical, and customer\-facing. You’ll be directly accountable for the success of your accounts, configuring, testing, and tuning AI agents while working closely with Product and Engineering to shape both our customers’ success and the future of the platform. We're looking for someone with strong product and project\-management instincts: someone who can walk into a customer's messy process, dig into the details, map it out precisely, and run a tight, structured implementation, not someone who wants to focus exclusively on an internal product roadmap. **Please Note:** This role will involve occasional on\-site work with customers, approximately 2 times per month, to support discovery sessions, technical workshops, and deployment phases. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Own the end\-to\-end post\-sale journey, from deployment scoping through onboarding, production, full adoption, and value realization, leading AI agent implementations that translate customer supply chain workflows into scalable automations. * Dig into customer processes in detail: map the workflow, identify exactly where automation should be applied, then configure, test, and tune agent behavior directly without always waiting on an engineering sprint. * Act as a strategic advisor to procurement and operations stakeholders, identifying where expanded automation drives the most ROI and making the business outcomes explicit—cost savings, cycle time reduction, and supplier risk mitigation. * Partner with Product and Engineering to surface customer insights that shape the roadmap, and with Sales to drive renewals and expansion within your book of business. * Build repeatable implementation playbooks and best practices as the team scales. **You’ll be successful in this role if you…** --------------------------------------------- * Think like a builder, not just a relationship manager—you want to get inside the product and understand how it actually works. * Are exceptional at running tight processes: structuring ambiguous problems, mapping workflows step by step, and driving a deployment to a clean finish. * Are energized by working directly with AI products and solving ambiguous customer problems with technology. * Have a strong instinct for where AI can drive ROI in complex operational workflows. * Thrive in fast\-moving startup environments, default to action over deliberation, and can simplify complex concepts for non\-technical audiences. **Qualifications** ------------------ * 3\+ years of experience, with a background in one of the following: a CS undergraduate degree paired with strategy consulting or investment banking; a Solutions Engineering role with a CS background; or product management (technical PM experience is a plus, not a requirement). * Comfortable with APIs, integrations, and agentic AI—a CS foundation means you can get up to speed fast and go deep when needed. * Strong project management skills with the ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and drive execution. * Proven experience (or clear aptitude) for leading complex, customer\-facing initiatives from kickoff through full adoption. * Strong communicator with the ability to present to senior stakeholders and navigate large organizations. **Bonus Points For:** * Background in procurement, supply chain, ERP systems, or enterprise operations. * Prior experience at a top\-tier consulting firm (e.g., MBB, Big 4 strategy arm) or in a Forward Deployed Engineer–style role. * Familiarity with workflow automation platforms or APIs. * Startup experience in high\-growth B2B SaaS. **What we value at Didero** --------------------------- * **We go beyond OTIF.** We’re obsessed with our customers and go above and beyond to ensure we’re their top supplier. We work hard to earn and maintain their trust. * **Own it.** We own what we do. We stand behind the quality of our work and do the right thing, especially when it costs us. * **Move fast. Learn faster.** We have a strong bias to action and shorten the cycle by following our curiosity to improve as we go. * **Be relentless.** When one route closes, we find another. * **Disagree, then commit.** This is an open contest of ideas. We’re direct, but with respect. We’re decisive, and everyone commits because we win together. **What We Offer:** ------------------ * Competitive compensation and equity * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * Memberships for One Medical, Talkspace, Teladoc, and Kindbody * Unlimited PTO — we trust you to take the time you need * Monthly wellness stipend via ClassPass * Tech equipment for your setup * Catered lunches (for those in the office) Compensation Range: $160K \- $250K

jobs.title: Embedded C Programmer - Entry Level
jobs.description: (Note: **Recruiters will contact you via Indeed Messages.**) Build the product. Masterthe craft. Deliver results. **Three things to know before you read further:** * **This job is C.** Not "embedded, generally." C at the register level is required to get started, even though many of our developers work on web\-based tools and other projects later. * **This job is fully in\-person**, on\-site every day in Ledgewood, NJ. No remote. No hybrid. * **Our screening is a real hands\-on hardware challenge**, not a whiteboard algorithm quiz (see details below). We need sharp, technically\-driven engineers who want full responsibility for embedded product development, from schematic design through firmware delivery and into the client's hands. You won't be handing off pieces of a puzzle. You'll architect, build, and ship complete solutions in C and Python, with measurable impact on every project. Our engineers talk directly to the people who use what we build. You will need to be a committed lifelong learner to succeed at this job. **The Challenge:** This is a high\-mix, low\-volume engineering environment. Every project is different. Deadlines are firm. You'll tackle new technical problems constantly, including bare\-metal firmware, network protocols, PCB layout, and database integration, and you'll be expected to deliver production\-quality results on schedule. We are increasingly an "AI\-first" company. We use these new tools aggressively wherever they help us serve clients better, from accelerating development to making sure nothing a client sends us sits unanswered. BUT we hire engineers who understand the WHY behind every line, because you can't review what you can't reason about. We don't ship anything we haven't thoroughly tested and validated ourselves. Our clients run critical infrastructure: emergency communications, utilities, railroads, fire alarm networks. When their equipment has a problem, they call us, and an engineer picks up (we don't have some separate "tech support" crew). Some of the most valuable work you'll do here starts on a screen\-share with a technician standing at a remote site with a voltmeter in his hand, and ends with improvements to the mainline firmware that all clients can use. **About the C Requirement:** C is the foundation of every remote\-monitoring device we build. It is not a "nice to have," and general "embedded" or "programming" ability is not a substitute for it. That said: if you're a strong, flexible developer without direct C experience, you're welcome to apply and give our take\-home challenge a shot. We've found the right kind of engineer can pick this up quickly, and the challenge is how you show us (and yourself) that you're that engineer. **Our Two\-Part Hardware Challenge:** Part 1 is a take\-home. Part 2 is on\-site. Both are the same kind of work: bit\-banging the I2C protocol on an Arduino, toggling the lines yourself, with no Wire library to hide behind. Part 1: **Take\-Home** (Tinkercad, virtual Arduino) Early in our process, you'll get a take\-home challenge in Tinkercad. It's a virtualized Arduino on your screen, talking to a simulated I/O expander chip. You don't need any hardware. You just need a web browser. You build the circuit, read the datasheet, write the C, and debug it one step at a time, on your own schedule. The point of Part 1 is simple: it tells you (and us) that you have enough skill to get started, before anyone makes a trip here unnecessarily. It's low\-stakes, and it's worth doing regardless of outcome. We don't want to plunge you into a role that isn't going to work well for you, and you don't want that either. At minimum, trying it will show you exactly where you stand. If the answer is "not yet," you'll know what to study, and you're welcome to come back. Candidates who are right for this job tend to enjoy it. Several have told us they finally understood how I2C actually works because they weren't allowed to use the library. Part 2: **On\-Site** (physical Arduino) If Part 1 goes well, you'll come to Ledgewood for an in\-person interview. That visit definitely includes a second challenge: the bit\-banging exercise on a real, physical Arduino at our bench, plus a short handwritten coding worksheet and a conversation with us. This is the real technical bar for the job. If you worked through Part 1 yourself and understood what you wrote, you'll likely arrive ready for Part 2\. **What You'll Be Responsible For:** * Full\-cycle embedded firmware development in C and Python: design, implementation, testing, and optimization * Network protocol performance at the register level: TCP/IP, UDP, SPI, I2C * Systematic debugging and root\-cause analysis of firmware and communication issues, including live troubleshooting sessions with client technicians * Schematic review and PCB layout using professional CAD tools (this comes later on; we'll train you on the toolchain) * Clear written documentation at every step: what you changed, why, how it was test equivalent) * Competence with network protocols and hardware interfaces * Functional ability in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and SQL * Some basic electronics background, enough to learn PCB design quickly * Fluency with AI tools as an accelerator, paired with the ability to work through a hard problem without them. We'll ask you to do both * The ability to explain a technical finding plainly, in writing or on a call, to someone who is smart but doesn't work with our product every day **What Sets You Apart:** * You've completed projects independently: hobbyist builds, personal engineering challenges, or self\-directed technical work carry significant weight here * School or work projects count, provided you were a primary technical contributor, not an observer * You have a systematic approach to learning new tools and can demonstrate rapid skill acquisition * You've helped someone else solve a technical problem and found that satisfying rather than annoying, and your instinct afterward was to fix the thing that made the problem possible. Teaching, tutoring, tech support, help forums, and lab partners all count **Is This You?** Some engineers want to be left alone with a compiler. That's a legitimate preference, but this is not the job for it. Here, the hardest problems arrive through a client. You get on the call, you find the actual cause, and you give them something that works today. Then, once you understand the root cause, you close it out permanently: a change to the mainline firmware, a hardware revision, a clearer web interface, a piece of documentation that stops the question from being asked again. One client's bug report gets solved for every other client forever. That's the standard here. This is not a support desk. You are not going to spend your career answering the same question. You're going to answer it once, well, and then go engineer it out of existence. If that appeals to you, keep reading. **Schedule and Pace:** We work hard. The baseline day is from 9am to about 6pm, and overtime is a normal part of the job when client deadlines call for it. We say so up front because we'd rather you know now than find out later. There is flexibility for the right person. **Location and Commute:** This role is fully in\-person, on\-site every day, in Ledgewood, NJ. There is no remote or hybrid option, now or later. All interviews are in person. You don't need to live in New Jersey. We have people commuting from Pennsylvania. What matters is drive time, and we'll be honest about what we've seen: commutes of about 45 minutes or longer have not usually worked out long\-term in this role. You should already be within that range, or have a genuine, concrete plan to relocate in the near future. **The Opportunity:** We will invest directly in your technical development. You'll gain hands\-on expertise across the full embedded product stack: firmware, hardware, networking, and systems integration. You'll work in an environment where AI is part of the standard toolkit, and where finding exactly what parts the AI got wrong is also part of the job. You'll even get to build something rarer, which is a reputation with clients who remember your name. But this requires commitment: consistent effort, disciplined learning, and a refusal to settle for "good enough." If you want to build real competence, not just credentials, and you're driven to take on challenging technical work that matters to real people, this is the role. **Details:** * Job Type: Full\-time * Schedule: 9am to 6pm baseline, overtime as needed * **Location: On\-site every day, Ledgewood, NJ (no remote or hybrid)** * Process: Take\-home Tinkercad challenge and short online assessments first, then an on\-site interview that includes the bit\-banging exercise on a physical Arduino Job Type: Full\-time Pay: Up to $62,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Forward Deployed AI Architect
jobs.description: Most enterprise AI initiatives stall between pilot and production. The demo works; the path to a system that runs a real business process, under real controls, with a real owner, is where they get stuck. The Forward Deployed AI Architect is the person we place inside the client to get them unstuck. You will be embedded with client business owners and engineering leaders, designing AI\-native, Enterprise AI and Applied AI solutions — assistants, RAG systems, agents, agentic workflows, autonomous components — and taking them from pilot to production. You will carry the architect's responsibilities (framing the problem, fitting the business scope exactly, making trade\-offs explicit, deciding what the system must not do) while sitting at the client's table, in their vocabulary, on their timeline. The role is modeled on the forward\-deployed engineering pattern but operates at the architecture level. It rewards people who like ownership, who can work with ambiguity without a home team beside them, and who measure themselves by what reached production at the client, not by what was presented. Req\# 1090267686 **Responsibilities** * Embed with a client account, working directly with business owners, product leaders, engineering teams, security, risk, and operations to take AI solutions from pilot to production * Design end\-to\-end AI\-native architectures: orchestration, retrieval, integration with systems of record, agent autonomy and guardrails, identity and authorization, evaluation, observability, and cost model * Own three artifacts that make your impact measurable: a capability economics model — what each AI capability costs and what it earns, so investment decisions are made on evidence; trust\-rung evidence for every agent — the documented proof of how much autonomy each agent has earned and under what controls; a knowledge\-graph slice of the client domain — the jobs.title: Civil Design Engineer
jobs.description: Do you like working with different project teams in a fast\-paced environment? Are you interested in joining an organization focused on making a positive impact? If so, we'd like to talk with you about growing with us. EnSafe is accepting applications for a **Civil Design Engineer** based out of our EnSafe **Nashville, Knoxville, TN,** or **Bowling Green, KY** offices EnSafe is an employee\-owned global environmental consulting and engineering firm. We strive to provide innovative, creative solutions for our clients. EnSafe specializes in custom solutions in Environmental Management and Planning, Civil Design Engineering, Environmental Restoration, Natural \& Water Resources, Health \& Safety, and Technology, with offices in the U.S. **What We Are Looking For** As a **Civil Design Engineer**, you will work on various projects in an environment that fosters creativity, collaboration at all levels, a culture of support, and professional growth. EnSafe emphasizes empowering staff to practice our profession passionately and without limitations. **What You Will Be Doing:** * Supporting and leading the engineering design effort for site civil, stormwater drainage, industrial wastewater, and utility design projects. * Projects include civil design, solid waste management/landfill design, impoundments, and development of plans and profiles. * Engineering design is for regulatory permitting, site development, specifications, and bid documents. * Problem\-solving across multi\-disciplinary teams. * Participating in and coordinating various design and construction meetings with clients and subcontractors (including Pre\-bid meetings) * Planning, scheduling, and conducting detailed phases of design work. * EnSafe is a sell/manage/do organization, so your duties will also include proposal/marketing support, project and practice management, and client project involvement where appropriate. **What You'll Need:** * Bachelor's degree in civil engineering with Civil 3D/CAD experience. * A minimum of 5 years of civil design experience, preferably with an Engineering consulting firm. * Current PE in the respective state. * Previous experience with civil engineering design capabilities with both municipal and industrial clients. * Critical thinking and problem\-solving skills. * Strong work ethic with attention to detail. * Ability to work on multiple projects, across various services and in a fast\-paced environment. * Group management and mentoring. * Regional travel is required; national travel for client meetings is likely. **Why Join EnSafe?** * **Employee\-Owned Advantage** EnSafe is 100% employee\-owned, with an ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan) since 1997\. That means when EnSafe succeeds, you succeed too, turning company growth directly into shared rewards. * **Commitment to Growth and Wellness** The company supports personalized career development, mentorship, and employee wellness initiatives such as health tracking tools. * **Purpose‑Driven Work** EnSafe's mission focuses on impactful environmental, health, and safety consulting—making a real difference in communities and is backed by its long\-standing technical credibility. * **Safety as a Value, Not Just a Service** Safety is deeply embedded in our culture, prioritizing employee well\-being in addition to helping clients maintain compliance. We stress that *"safety is part of everything we do."* * **A Culture of Freedom \& Ownership** At EnSafe, our career philosophy is built on freedom. The freedom to take initiative, achieve your goals, and shape your own career path Employees are encouraged to pursue growth in a flexible, entrepreneurial environment. * **Challenging, Creative Work** Workdays at EnSafe are anything but ordinary, fast\-paced, dynamic, and filled with opportunities to tackle projects in environmental consulting, health \& safety, engineering, and technology. Every day calls for creativity, innovation, and agile problem\-solving. \#LI\-CO1 **About EnSafe** EnSafe began as a two\-person firm in 1980, navigating complex regulatory compliance issues on behalf of our clients. We nurture our people with growth and development opportunities. We build enduring, trustful relationships with each of our clients, with a focus on high ethical and safety standards. We build this reputation by attracting high\-quality people and retaining them for the long term. At EnSafe, we are dedicated to fostering a diverse and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles at our company. EnSafe is committed to being an EEO employer and all qualified candidates will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, citizenship, age (except for bona fide occupational qualifications), sex, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, military or veteran status, any other status protected by federal, state, or local law, or association with a person on the basis on one or more of the foregoing. jobs.title: Test Automation Engineer (T-Plan Robot) - Distribution Tools - 26-360
jobs.description: **Why YOU want this position** At Enverus, we're committed to empowering the global quality of life by helping our customers make energy affordable and accessible to the world. We are the most trusted energy\-dedicated SaaS company, with a platform built to maximize value from generative AI, and our innovative solutions are reshaping the way energy is consumed and managed. By offering anytime, anywhere access to analytics and insights, we're helping our customers make better decisions that help provide communities around the world with clean, affordable energy. The energy industry is changing fast. But we've continued to lead the way in energy technology, creating intelligent connections across the entire energy ecosystem, from renewables, power and utilities, to oil and gas and financial institutions. Our solutions create more efficient production and distribution, capital allocation, renewable energy development, investment and sourcing, and help reduce costs by automating crucial business operations. Of course, this wouldn't be possible without our people, which is why we have built a team of individuals from a diverse range of backgrounds. Are you ready to help power the global quality of life? Join Enverus, and be a part of creating a brighter, more sustainable tomorrow. SBS, an Enverus company, is seeking a Test Automation Engineer to join the Distribution Tools team, reporting to Matthew Rickard, Director of Software Development. This is a dedicated, 100%\-automation\-focused role: your mandate is to convert our existing manual regression coverage into reliable automated tests, building on our existing investment in T\-Plan Robot for image\-based desktop and CAD GUI automation. A core part of this role is applying AI tools to the hardest part of test automation — writing and maintaining the tests themselves — while building in the validation steps needed to keep AI\-assisted tests repeatable and trustworthy, not just fast to produce. This role starts embedded in Distribution Tools, but it is designed to grow: the frameworks, practices, and tooling you build are expected to extend across SBS's broader desktop application portfolio (AUD, ABD, DDS, P4A/P4I, and the SDS suite) as the practice matures, and your remit will expand accordingly over time. **What you will do** **Test Automation \& Coverage** * Own automation of existing manual regression test suites for Distribution Tools products, using T\-Plan Robot as the primary automation engine for CAD\-based desktop GUI testing. * Design and implement automated test frameworks and reusable patterns for desktop and Revit\-integrated applications. * Execute automated test suites, analyze failures, and document defects with clear reproduction steps. * Maintain and continuously improve test automation infrastructure and its integration with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps). **AI\-Assisted Test** * Authoring Evaluate and apply AI/LLM tools to accelerate the authoring and maintenance of GUI test scripts. * Build generate\-then\-validate workflows so AI\-assisted test creation produces repeatable, trustworthy regression coverage rather than brittle, one\-off scripts. * Document what works, and what doesn't, so the approach can be adopted by other teams. * Collaboration \& Process Partner with developers and product owners across Distribution Tools to prioritize the highest\-value regression scenarios to automate first. * Participate in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives) as an embedded member of the Distribution Tools team. * Provide feedback on code quality and testability during code reviews. **Reporting \& Growth** * Track and report on automation coverage, defect trends, and time saved to build the business case for expanding the practice. * As the practice matures, extend frameworks and mentorship to test engineers on other desktop product teams (Substation Tools, GTI). **What skills you should have** * 5\+ years of combined experience in manual and automated testing of desktop or engineering software * Hands\-on experience with T\-Plan Robot or a comparable image/OCR\-based GUI automation tool for desktop applications * Practical, applied experience using AI and LLM tools in a development or QA workflow, able to speak to both productivity gains and repeatability risks * Proficiency in at least one general\-purpose test automation framework, such as NUnit, Selenium, or WinAppDriver * Experience with CI/CD pipelines, such as GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps **Skills that stand out** * Familiarity with Autodesk Revit, AutoCAD, or Inventor and their automation APIs * Experience standing up a test automation practice from a limited existing base, rather than extending a mature one * Background in utility, energy, or infrastructure engineering software **Our Technology Stack** T\-Plan Robot, NUnit, Selenium, WinAppDriver, SQL, Postman, Swagger, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Autodesk Revit, AutoCAD, Inventor

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Applied AI
jobs.description: **Grow with us** ---------------- **About this opportunity:** **Software Engineer, AI Technology Governance \& Developer Foundation, Austin, Texas** **This is an on\-site, hybrid work schedule and not opne for remote work.** Build the foundation for safe, scalable AI\-assisted development at Ericsson! AI\-assisted development is moving quickly—from Code OSS\-based IDEs with telecom\-specific tooling to agentic development environments used across the organization. We are building the governance, infrastructure, and developer platforms that make this evolution secure, reusable, and scalable. As a Software Engineer on the AI Technology Governance and Foundation team, you will help shape the backbone of AI\-assisted software development across the organization. Integrate governance and compliance controls into CI/CD pipelines and developer workflows. Design and implement APIs, tools, and services that connect AI assistants, development environments, and internal platforms. Help build the next generation of agentic IDEs and Code OSS\-based development experiences. Identify and close gaps related to software reuse, IP protection, security, and responsible AI adoption. Partner with developers, security teams, platform engineers, and technology leaders to turn organizational needs into practical engineering solutions. Take ownership of ambiguous requirements and drive solutions from concept and MVP through production adoption. Measure adoption, usability, reliability, and impact across the developer community. **What you will bring.** Strong software engineering fundamentals, including design, testing, maintainability, and operational ownership. Hands\-on experience building or integrating AI\- and LLM\-based development tools. Experience designing or integrating APIs, developer tools, plugins, agents, or platform services. Practical fluency with CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices. A security\-minded engineering approach, including awareness of secure design, access control, data protection, and supply\-chain or IP risks. Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work across teams and technical domains. A builder’s mindset: practical, curious, outcome\-oriented, and comfortable making sound decisions with incomplete information. Experience delivering software that is adopted and used in production—not only prototypes or proofs of concept. **Join our Team** ----------------- **Highly desired experience**. Developer\-experience platforms, internal tooling, or engineering productivity systems. Code OSS, VS Code extensions, IDE integrations, or developer portals. AI marketplaces, model/tool registries, or agent frameworks. Software supply\-chain security, IP governance, compliance automation, or policy\-as\-code. Platform engineering and infrastructure used across large engineering organizations. Taking an ambiguous problem from 0 to 1 and turning it into an adopted tool, standard, or service. What you can learn. You do not need to arrive with deep expertise in every part of AI governance, agentic development, telecom tooling, or intellectual\-property management. The team can help you build domain knowledge in these areas. What matters most is your ability to learn quickly, engineer responsibly, collaborate effectively, and deliver solutions that work at organizational scale. This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys building foundational infrastructure rather than isolated features. Designing standards, registries, and platforms that serve hundreds of developers. Solving ambiguous, cross\-functional problems involving security, IP, reuse, and governance. Balancing developer velocity with safety, trust, and operational quality. Turning fast\-moving AI experimentation into reliable, reusable engineering capabilities. Moving quickly from an initial idea to an MVP, then improving it through real\-world adoption and feedback. **What happens once you apply?** Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like. jobs.title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
jobs.description: **About MISUMI Americas** MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world\-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas. **Accounts Receivable Specialist** **Misumi USA \| Full\-Time** **PLEASE NOTE: The person in this role will work from our office in Schaumburg, IL.** MISUMI Americas is a division of MISUMI Group, a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. We pair a massive catalog of components with a world\-class digital manufacturing platform, helping engineers and procurement teams move faster across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago area, we're a trusted partner to some of the most innovative companies in the Americas. **Why This Role Matters** As our Accounts Receivable Specialist, you'll own a portfolio of B2B and B2C accounts — some straightforward, some genuinely complicated. You'll be the person who catches credit risk early, negotiates repayment plans that actually work, and keeps disputes from turning into write\-offs. This isn't a back\-office, process\-the\-paperwork role: you'll work directly with sales, customer service, and finance to solve problems that affect the company's bottom line. **What You'll Do** * Make collection calls and follow up on past\-due accounts with customers directly. * Own day\-to\-day credit evaluation for your portfolio, with support from your manager. * Assess credit exposure for new and existing customers using D\&B reports and other data, and apply that analysis to sound open\-credit\-term decisions. * Investigate and resolve disputed accounts receivable in partnership with sales and customer service. * Keep customer account information current and accurate in the system. * Process credit card payments through our accounting systems. * Manage dunning and escalate serious delinquency issues appropriately. * Troubleshoot outstanding account issues and drive them to resolution. * Review and approve or hold orders using sound judgment on customer risk. * Apply Lock Box payments and reconcile customer accounts. * Process customer refunds and maintain accurate filing records. * Contribute ideas for process improvement — we want people who make the job better, not just do the job. * Provide team coverage for time\-off requests, and partner across business units, sales, customer service, and finance on credit and customer service matters. **What You Bring** * 3 \- 5 years of experience in Accounts Receivable, Order\-to\-Cash (O2C), and Credit \& Collections — B2B experience strongly preferred. * A track record managing complex, varied customer portfolios independently. * Strong negotiation and communication skills — you can hold a firm line on collections while keeping the customer relationship intact. * A customer\-focused mindset paired with real attention to detail. * Comfort influencing stakeholders outside your own department. * Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field preferred. * Experience with SAP or NetSuite preferred. **Bonus Points** * Analytical chops in Tableau, Power BI, Sigma, or SQL. * Experience driving workflow automation or process enhancement. * Hands\-on use of AI tools in a finance or collections workflow. **A Few Practical Notes** This role is based in Schaumburg, IL. It involves routine sitting, walking, and computer work, and occasional international travel (about 1% annually) for team meetings, offsites, trade shows, or conferences. **Salary Range:** **$50,000 \- $63,200 base salary per year, depending on experience.** **Benefits include, but are not limited to:** * **Comprehensive medical and dental coverage** * **401(k) plan** * **Generous PTO and leave programs** We're actively seeking teammates who: * Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company. * Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team. * Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth. * Have an 'always learning' mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins. * Help us continue to build a world\-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

metrics, and data products. + **Member 360:** Develop comprehensive member‑centric data products that enable insights into behavior, engagement, and opportunities. + **Standardized Metrics:** Deliver enterpr . + **BI Integration:** Optimize models for consumption in Power BI and Sigma Computing. * **Advanced Analytics \& ML Support** + **Predictive Analytics Infrastructure:** Build the data infrastructure and feature stores required for predictive modeling (risk, churn, behavior, growth). + **Prescriptive Analytics:** Enable next‑best‑action and prescriptive decision‑support pipelines. + jobs.title: Technical Co-founder (CTO)
jobs.description: ### **The Opportunity** FutureSight is seeking an applied AI builder to co\-found and lead the technical direction of a new B2B AI venture from the ground up. This is a co\-founder partnership with founder\-level equity and founder\-level authority, not a salaried executive role. We are not looking for someone who manages engineers from a distance or adds AI language to a traditional CTO resume. We are looking for someone who can take a vague problem, frame it clearly, design the right system, and turn it into something customers actually use and trust. If you've gone from ambiguity to working product before — and you want to do it again with the backing of an experienced venture building team — this is the opportunity. This is a full\-time, exclusive commitment to building and owning a single B2B AI venture from the ground up. ### **About FutureSight** FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co\-creates world\-class software companies with values\-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale. You'll co\-create with a proven venture building team, including: * John Carbrey – 4x founder, bootstrapped to $100M ARR * Joshua Auslander – Seasoned CFO and strategic advisor with $200M aggregate exits * Alan Smith – Globally recognized early stage validation expert, 24 products launched, an exit, 5M\+ books sold * Prathna Ramesh – Early\-stage investor and capital strategy advisor ### **The Partnership** * Founder\-level equity with meaningful ownership from inception, aligned across funding rounds * Founder\-level authority, including co\-decision rights on product, technology, hiring, fundraising, and strategy * Pre\-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow\-on funding * A proven process and playbook for taking ventures from 0 to 1, informed by our team's prior experience and mistakes * Venture building and scaling resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one * Investor and advisor network across B2B AI and early\-stage capital markets * A true co\-creation model in which you operate as CTO with FutureSight's cross\-functional team as your partner — building alongside you. ### **What you'll own** As Co\-Founder \& CTO, you will set the venture's technical direction and lead its execution. This is a co\-founder role, not a CTO hire. * Technical Direction — Own problem framing, architecture, system design, and product judgment from day one, translating rough product intent into structure, context, and specs that both humans and AI systems can execute against * Build — Use modern tools and frontier models to move fast without sacrificing quality or maintainability, designing agentic systems with first\-principles thinking and knowing when orchestration adds genuine leverage versus when simplicity is the better call * Customer \& Market — Be the primary technical voice in early customer conversations, understanding real workflows and shaping the right product rather than just shipping quickly * Traction Before Scale — Prove there is something worth scaling before thinking about scaling it, focusing on traction first and team\-building second * Capital — Contribute to fundraising, from investor conversations to due diligence * Team — Recruit and grow a technical team when the time is right, and establish the cultural foundation of the company ### **Co\-Founder Profile** * Proven track record of shipping AI products to real users under real\-world constraints — not research, experiments, or prototypes * Deep practical experience with frontier models, LLM\-based systems, and agentic architectures, with strong system design instincts and a bias for simplicity and maintainability * Strong translation layer skills — able to turn messy product intent into clear structure, constraints, and specs that both humans and AI systems can act on * Close to the customer, comfortable in customer conversations, and able to let real workflows shape what you build * Rigorous about verification — feedback loops, evaluation, and systems that can be trusted * Prior experience as a technical co\-founder or early engineering leader, with fundraising experience a strong plus * Founder at heart — energized by ambiguity, able to go far alone, and ready to commit fully ### **How to Apply** Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate. FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

jobs.title: Scientist
jobs.description: **Position Objective:** The Scientist will provide support services to the National Institute on Aging (NIA) within the National Institutes of Health. **Duties and Responsibilities:** * Design and implement novel web\-based data collection systems and programs for Realtime medical examination data collection in the most appropriate programming language. 1 * Create novel participant and personnel management systems to meet study operational requirements such as tracking participants or scheduling participant visits; implement and maintain programs and databases to perform this function. 2 * Create system for generating reports to participants based on data collected in the field, by laboratory tests, by instruments, and by information entered into web\-based forms. 3 * Design, implement, and maintain databases that correspond to web\-based programs, and implement programmatic mechanisms for transfers and backups from data collected in real\-time on medical instruments such as EKG and DXA. * Design, implement, test, and deploy software that minimizes data entry by staff and makes maximum use of instrument interfaces without compromising functionality, availability, reliability, access control, security, and performance of computing services for study staff and investigators. * Perform database administration and programming. * Perform system administration of web\-server systems to ensure ongoing operations * without any failure of data entry. * Write reports and documentation related to programming tasks; ensure that programs are clearly written, well documented, and can be supported and maintained by any programmer with an intermediate level of skill in the language using source\-code configuration and version control management. * Export data from relational database to other software such as statistical programs (e.g., SAS) when needed by researchers and other programming personnel. * Analyze problems and propose solutions that enhance the operation of the web\-based * data collection activities. * Provide expert recommendations in application of Perl CGI to other study investigators. * Make recommendations to physicians and technologists about optimal use of electronic media for record keeping and other study\-related data management. * Work products and documents related to designing and implementing novel web based data collection systems and programs for real\-time medical examination data collection; create novel participant and personnel management systems to meet study operational requirements; create a system for generating reports to participants based on data collected in the field. * Work products and documents related to designing, implementing, and maintaining databases that correspond to web\-based programs, and implement programmatic mechanisms for transfers and backups from data collected in real\-time on medical instruments; design, implement, test, and deploy software that minimizes data entry by staff and makes maximum use of instrument interfaces. * Work products and documents related to performing database administration and programming; perform system administration of web\-server systems to ensure ongoing operations without any failure of data entry; analyze problems and propose solutions that enhance the operation of the web\-based data collection activities. * Work products and documents related to providing expert recommendations in application of Perl CGI; making recommendations about optimal use of electronic media for record keeping and other study\-related data management. * Computer generated work including writing reports and documentation related to programming tasks; export data from relational database to other software such as statistical programs. **Basic Qualifications:** * Ph.D. in a related discipline * 3 years of specialized experience plus a Master’s degree is equivalent to a Ph.D. * Minimum of 5 years demonstrated experience performing similar functions * Minimum of 3 years of experience in a computing environment, and experience with system utilities and system software maintenance utilities * Knowledge of programming languages and methodologies such as PHP, Perl, AJAX, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Java, Bash, and batch scripting * Ability to write novel web\-based applications on Linux server to be used by OS\-agnostic clients in a variety of browsers * Experience working with various databases such as MySQL, and knowledge of SQL language and MySQL database management, access control, replication, and maintenance * Fluency in Web Server Administration, Apache HTTP Server, HTML, XML and Web site development and administration. Excellent writing skills or awards for writing **Preferred Qualifications:** * Ability to communicate effectively, orally and in writing, with non\-technical and technical staff * Detail\-oriented and possess strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks and projects * This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required by this position. jobs.title: Senior Systems & Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: Senior Systems \& Infrastructure Engineer **New York Metropolitan Area \| Primarily Remote with Occasional Client\-Site Work** **Full\-Time \| $90,000\-$120,000** Solve the Problems Other Engineers Escalate GEM Technologies is looking for an experienced Senior Systems \& Infrastructure Engineer who enjoys solving difficult technical problems and taking ownership of them through resolution. This is a hands\-on senior infrastructure position, not a management role or traditional help desk position. You will be one of the technical resources our team and clients rely on for complex infrastructure issues, production incidents, escalations, migrations and projects across multiple client environments. We are looking for an engineer who can step into a difficult situation, troubleshoot across technologies, determine the root cause, communicate clearly with the people involved, and remain accountable until the issue is resolved. If you enjoy being the engineer brought in when standard troubleshooting has not solved the problem, this may be a good fit. What You'll Do You will work across multiple client environments with different technologies, configurations and business requirements. Your responsibilities will include: * Own the investigation and resolution of complex infrastructure incidents and escalations. * Administer and troubleshoot Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS and DHCP. * Support Microsoft 365 and Entra ID environments, including identity, authentication, MFA and Conditional Access. * Troubleshoot and support virtualization environments using VMware and/or Hyper\-V. * Diagnose networking issues involving firewalls, VPNs, VLANs, routing, switching and connectivity. * Support backup, disaster recovery and business continuity systems. * Plan and execute infrastructure migrations, upgrades and modernization projects. * Perform root\-cause analysis and implement or recommend changes that prevent recurring problems. * Use PowerShell, scripting, automation and other tools where they can improve reliability and efficiency. * Create and maintain clear technical documentation. * Work directly with clients, vendors and other GEM engineers during projects and technical incidents. * Provide occasional onsite support at client locations in the New York City metropolitan area. What We're Looking For We care more about demonstrated technical depth, troubleshooting ability and ownership than a perfect list of certifications or products on a resume. Strong candidates will have substantial hands\-on experience supporting production IT infrastructure and personally resolving complex technical problems. You should have strong experience in most of these areas: Microsoft Infrastructure* Windows Server and Active Directory * Group Policy, DNS and DHCP * Microsoft 365 and Entra ID * Identity, MFA and Conditional Access Virtualization and Core Infrastructure* VMware vSphere/ESXi and/or Microsoft Hyper\-V * Server and storage infrastructure * Backup and disaster recovery Networking and Security* Firewalls, VPNs, VLANs, routing and switching * Network and infrastructure troubleshooting * System hardening, EDR, MFA and related security technologies You should also be comfortable communicating directly with clients and explaining complex technical issues to both technical and nontechnical audiences. Experience working for an MSP, technology consulting firm or other multi\-client environment is strongly preferred. We will also consider engineers from complex internal IT environments who can demonstrate comparable technical breadth, independence and ownership. Working at GEM GEM Technologies is a managed IT and cybersecurity services company supporting organizations with complex technology environments. We are a small, experienced team. Senior engineers at GEM are not confined to one narrow technology or isolated within a large department. You will work across technologies, interact directly with clients and have meaningful responsibility for the systems and environments we support. That environment requires versatility and accountability, but it also provides something that can be difficult to find in a large organization: the opportunity to understand the complete environment, solve challenging problems and have a visible impact on the outcome. We value engineers who are curious, continue learning, share knowledge, document their work and take ownership. We also encourage the responsible use of AI, scripting and automation to improve troubleshooting, documentation and operational efficiency while maintaining appropriate security and protection of client information. Much of the work can be performed remotely. However, occasional onsite work at client locations in the New York City metropolitan area is an important part of the position. Candidates must be willing and able to provide onsite support when required. **Requirements** Experience That Will Set You Apart We are particularly interested in candidates with meaningful hands\-on experience in one or more of the following: * Microsoft Exchange Server and hybrid Exchange environments * Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD) * Citrix NetScaler / ADC * Advanced VMware infrastructure * Advanced networking and firewall troubleshooting * Veeam or similar backup and disaster recovery platforms * PowerShell scripting and automation * Infrastructure migrations and major upgrades Candidates should bring strong, hands\-on proficiency across most of these technologies, with deeper expertise in several areas. Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **New York, NY, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 8 years of experience with software development using Python or similar coding languages. * Experience building pipelines for structured and unstructured data using both vector databases and RAG\-like architectures to power enterprise AI solutions. * Experience taking production\-grade AI\-driven solutions from conception to launch for customers. * Experience leading technical discovery sessions with customers. * Experience architecting AI systems on cloud platforms (e.g., Google Cloud Platform (GCP)). ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master’s degree or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field. * Experience implementing multi\-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK) and complex patterns (e.g., ReAct, self\-reflection, hierarchical delegation). * Knowledge of Large Language Model (LLM) native metrics (e.g., tokens/sec, cost\-per\-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing. **About the job** ----------------- As a Generative AI (GenAI) Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Google Cloud, you will be an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier Artificial Intelligence (AI) products and production\-grade reality within partners for our customers. You will function as an innovator\-builder, moving beyond high\-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke and scalable agentic solutions directly with our partners, for and within the customer’s environment. You will address blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state\-management issues that prevent AI from reaching enterprise\-grade maturity. You will serve a dual purpose: providing white glove deployment of complex AI systems and acting as a critical connector and feedback loop for the partner to Google, transforming real\-world field and partner insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap. You will serve as the agent engineer bridging the gap between AI prototypes and production\-grade reality for our strategic AI partners and their own FDE teams. It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go\-To\-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $262000 \- $364000 (USD) \+ 25% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Serve as a tech lead and developer with strategic AI partners for complex AI applications, working with partner teams to transition from rapid prototypes to production\-grade, replicable agentic workflows (e.g., multi\-agent systems, MCP servers) that drive measurable return on investment (ROI). * Build high\-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure partner developed agentic systems meet rigorous requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency. * Identify repeatable partner and field patterns and friction points in Google’s AI stack, converting them into reusable modules or formal product feature requests for the Engineering teams. * Be able to co\-build with a strategic AI partner’s forward deployed engineering team to instill Google\-grade development best practices. * Help partners to build their own agentic delivery capabilities to set them up for long term success, focusing on the ROI at customer engagements ensuring customer activation. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Product Manager, AI Overviews/Mode Quality, Google Search
jobs.description: Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **New York, NY, USA; Mountain View, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * 3 years of experience in product management or related technical role. * 1 year of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end\-to\-end, 0 to 1, etc). * Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows. * Experience with GenAI model training or quality experience. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree in a technology or business related field. * 2 years of experience in a business function or role (e.g., strategic marketing, business operations, consulting). * 2 years of experience in a role preparing and delivering technical presentations to senior leadership. * 2 years of experience working cross\-functionally with engineering, UX/UI, sales finance, and other stakeholders. * 1 year of experience in software development or engineering. * Experience with GenAI Consumer facing products. **About the job** ----------------- At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day. In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development. One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users. Search has been at an inflection point. AI and large language models have been driving transformational change on what’s possible and how Search works. Our mission is to provide the most helpful and trustworthy AI responses with SoTA models, making it effortless to explore, access and understand information with AI Overviews and AI Mode. Our commitment is to help users globally as a thought partner, save them time and effort, and help them learn and complete tasks efficiently. As a Product Manager on this team, you’ll help build this future. In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $138000 \- $197000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Understand engaged GenAI \+ Search product landscape. * Work closely across Search Intelligence, GDM/Research and cross\-functional (XFN) teams to define product strategy for key modeling capabilities and quality improvements that drive more helpful conversational experiences and unlock new use cases. * Own model evaluations, live experiments and user feedback analysis to identify win/loss patterns, and use them along with latest user research insights to inform product quality efforts. * Understand and navigate the complexities with building GenAI product for billions of users across 40\+ languages. * Operate in a high\-paced, rapidly changing environment. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. jobs.description: In accordance with Washington state law, we are highlighting our comprehensive benefits package, which is available to all eligible US based employees. Benefits for this role include: * Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance * Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with company match * Paid Time Off: 20 days of vacation per year, accruing at a rate of 6\.15 hours per pay period for the first five years of employment * Sick Time: 40 hours/year (increased to 69 hours/year for Seattle) including 5 discretionary sick days per instance * Maternity Leave (Short\-Term Disability \+ Baby Bonding): 28\-30 weeks * Baby Bonding Leave: 18 weeks * Holidays: 13 paid days per year Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Sunnyvale, CA, USA; Seattle, WA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * 5 years of experience in program or project management. * Experience in supply or demand planning within supply chain management (e.g., forecasting, supplier management, inventory management, capacity management). * Experience working with supply chain analytics (e.g., scripting, dashboards, forecasting). ### **Preferred qualifications:** * 5 years of experience managing cross\-functional or cross\-team projects. * Experience with data center hardware technology and data center capacity planning and budgeting. * Experience with change management success across capacity planning, resource management and delivery, new product introduction, supply chain management, or infrastructure deployment. * Experience managing programs and cross\-functional teams, with excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills. **About the job** ----------------- Google Cloud Platform is rapidly growing its global footprint and product offerings, while changing the way the world uses computing. Capacity at the right place, at the right time, in the right form is a prerequisite to meet customer needs, enable GCP business growth, and run our business efficiently. If you are interested in solving this really complex problem at a global scale across GCP products and top accounts, look no further. As a Program Manager, you will use your technical and business depth, excellent organizational, communication, and people management skills to work with stakeholders ranging from sales, customer engineering, professional services organization, product, and engineering. Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $159000 \- $230000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Lead the coordination of capacity planning activities for some of Google Cloud AI/ML product portfolios. * Analyze customer usage patterns and lead consensus demand planning processes with account teams to build long\-term demand forecasts that anticipate resource needs for long lead time products. * Identify and mitigate potential capacity bottlenecks through proactive monitoring and demonstrate operational excellence to minimize downtime and service disruptions for strategic customers. * Lead regular capacity review meetings with stakeholders to communicate performance metrics, discuss future requirements, and align business objectives with technical capabilities. * Design and implement tooling and automation in partnership with Google Cloud engineering teams to deliver operational excellence and reduce manual toil.
