jobs.description: Project Manager **Required Qualifications (as evidenced by an attached resume):** Bachelor's degree (foreign equivalent or higher). Five (5\) years of progressively responsible, directly related full\-time experience in construction management, budgeting, project development, and/or a related field. Three (3\) years of direct supervisory experience in minor rehabilitation and new construction, including project cost and schedule oversight. Knowledge of Building and Fire Codes. Knowledge of construction management software. Project Management experience. Highly skilled in Microsoft Office Suite. Must have, keep and maintain the appropriate valid NYS Driver’s License; have a motor vehicle record which is free from major violations or a pattern of repeat violations. **(\*\*\*Out\-of\-State Applicants, see "Special Notes”).** **Preferred Qualifications:** Advanced degree (foreign equivalent or higher). Professional license (PE, RA) or professional certification (PMP, PgMP, CAPM, CEM, CEO). Six (6\) or more years of full\-time experience in construction management, budgeting, project development, and/or a related field. Experience with minor rehabilitation and new construction in a University, Healthcare, Hospital Construction, or similar setting. OSHA certification. **Brief Description of Duties:** The Project Manager will provide professional direction and oversight for all new construction, renovation activities and presidential initiatives occurring on campus. This includes responsibility for all duties necessary for project planning such as identifying required labor and labor hours, calculating cost estimates based on trade rates/hours, working with trades unions in workforce designations, managing and supervising assigned trades, contract labor and services for minor rehab and new construction services. Additionally, to minimize the disruption of campus services, an essential function of the Project Manager role will be to facilitate the coordination of new construction and/or renovations with campus administrators and stakeholders as well as physical plant staff. The Project Manager will represent the University in the development, planning, and construction activity performed by contractors and in\-house Stony Brook SFE employees. The incumbent is directly responsible for managing a fluctuating workforce to complete projects on time and within budget to meet the needs of the University. The successful candidate must be able to work independently and on multiple initiatives simultaneously. The Project Manager must have a well\-established record of conducting impactful presentations to varying audiences and achievement in providing construction project management services to ensure cost effective project completion and continued high\-quality services. Under the supervision of the Associate Vice President for Campus Planning, Design, and Construction, the Project Manager will provide professional direction and oversight of the day\-to\-day operations for all new construction and renovation activities associated with the development of the assigned project. The Project Manager must be able to perform Project Management functions to ensure the successful completion of capital construction projects, including Develop, gain necessary approval and control of project scope, project budget, schedule, contract documents and resource plan; quality and schedule parameters / risk management. Ensure timely project completion through project scheduling, monitoring critical path, expediting material deliveries, managing material and documents submittals/ approvals in accordance with standards and policy. The Project Manager must be able to demonstrate the ability to prioritize multiple tasks and demands, as well as supervise a highly skilled team of trades, contract labor and services. Responsibilities further consist of managing various sizes and volumes of projects from pre\-construction planning through build out and space occupancy phases including project closeout with financial reconciliation. This individual will serve as the primary stakeholder for each assigned project and the single point of contact for coordinating design and construction responsibilities with third party consultants, in\-house design team, contractors, vendors and government agencies. This individual will act as a liaison between internal cross\-functional technical teams and the university leadership team. jobs.title: Project Quality Specialist
jobs.description: **Strasburg Rail Road Company** **Position Description** **POSITION TITLE:** Project Quality Specialist **FLSA:** Non\-Exempt **Retirement:** Railroad Retirement **Worker Category:** Full\-time **POSITION REPORTS TO:** Mechanical Shop Superintendent **POSITION PURPOSE:** The Project Quality Specialist assists with the direction of maintenance and restoration projects for steam locomotives and historic railroad equipment. This unique role blends project coordination with quality assurance to ensure all work meets company standards, regulatory requirements (e.g., FRA compliance), and completion deadline goals. This position must also perform hands\-on work as needed. Ideal candidates will have a strong appreciation for historic machinery, mechanical systems, and heritage railroading, coupled with the ability to multitask, adhere to timelines, and accurately document work. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES:** Project Coordination: * Plan, coordinate, and schedule maintenance and restoration activities for steam locomotives, passenger cars, and other vintage railroad equipment. * Track project timelines, resources, and material procurement. * Coordinate workflow of projects assigned to the mechanical shop. * Ensure completion of projects on schedule and to SRC's world\-renowned quality standards. * Maintain working knowledge of the design, construction, repair, maintenance, and operation of historic and modern rail equipment. * Work cooperatively with engineering staff to create effective designs and drawings. * Maintain detailed records of work performed. * Organize and lead regular project meetings and progress reviews. Quality Control Management: * Ensure that work is performed as required by FRA regulation or ASME/NBIC code when applicable. * Perform inspections and audits on work in progress and completed tasks to verify compliance with technical standards and project deliverables. * Document and address quality issues, nonconformities, and recommend corrective actions. * Work closely with pressure vessel quality control manager to ensure pressure vessel jobs are completed in accordance with SRC's pressure vessel quality control manual. * Assist with mechanical work in all departments as needed. * Adhere to and enforce SRC safety policies and procedures. * Perform additional duties as required. **QUALIFICATIONS:** * Associate or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Technology, Project Management, or a related field \- or equivalent hands\-on experience in railroad mechanical work. * 3\+ years of experience in project coordination and/or mechanical restoration, preferably in a railroad, museum, or industrial setting. * Familiarity with steam locomotive systems, including boilers, running gear, air brakes, and controls. * Strong understanding of Federal Railroad Administration (FRA) regulations and best practices in heritage rail operations. * Working knowledge of OSHA regulations and safe work practices. * Proficient in technical documentation and project tracking tools (e.g., spreadsheets, maintenance logs, and Gantt charts). * Self\-motivation, self\-direction, and confidence to take initiative. * Excellent interpersonal communication and conflict resolution skills. * Organizational skills with careful attention to detail. * Familiarity with Oracle NetSuite ERP preferred * Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite products, including Word, Excel, and Outlook. * Ability to forecast resource needs. * Willingness and desire to learn. * Additional qualifications such as familiarity with CAD drawing software, mechanical engineering principles, machine tool operation and experience as a certified conductor or engineer are desirable. **WORKING CONDITIONS:** * Full\-time, minimum forty (40\) hours per week. Regular shop hours are 7:30 am to 4:00 pm, Monday through Friday. Shift may vary due to changing projects, priorities, and other factors. * Work is primarily indoors. * Work requires regular in\-person contact with Team Members, customers, and vendors. * Occasional exposure to very hot or very cold temperatures. * Frequent exposure in a shop setting to soot, dust, oil, paint, and other substances. * Use of office equipment and business technology includes, but is not limited to, computers, tablets, mobile phones, VOIP telephone system, copier and two\-way radio. * Frequent need for personal protective equipment. * Extended periods of walking or standing. * Infrequent travel required. **INTENT AND FUNCTION OF JOB DESCRIPTION:** Job descriptions assist organizations in ensuring that the hiring process is fairly administered and that qualified Team Members are selected. They are also essential to an effective appraisal system and related promotion, transfer, layoff, and termination decisions. Well\-constructed job descriptions have been reviewed to ensure that only essential functions and basic duties have been included. Peripheral tasks only incidentally related to each position have been excluded. Requirements, skills, and abilities included have been determined to be the minimal standards required to successfully perform the positions. In no instance, however, should the duties, responsibilities, and requirements delineated be interpreted as all\-inclusive. Supervisors as deemed appropriate may assign additional functions and requirements. In accordance to the Americans with Disabilities Act, it is possible that requirements may be modified to reasonably accommodate disabled individuals. However, no accommodations will be made which may pose serious health or safety risks to the Team Member or others or which impose undue hardships on the organization. Job descriptions are not intended as and do not create employment contracts. The organization maintains its status as an at\-will employer. Team Members can be terminated for any reason not prohibited by law.

jobs.title: Helpdesk Technician
jobs.description: About Stratus Services Stratus Services is a growing Managed Service Provider (MSP) delivering IT support, cybersecurity, cloud, and technology solutions to organizations across Alaska and beyond. We're looking for an **IT Support Technician** to join our Anchorage team. This position is ideal for someone who already has hands\-on IT support experience and is ready to move beyond basic Tier 1 troubleshooting into more advanced Microsoft 365, networking, endpoint, and infrastructure support. This is an **in\-office position in Anchorage, Alaska**. What You'll Do You'll work directly with our clients and technical team to troubleshoot problems, support users, maintain endpoints, and resolve day\-to\-day technology issues. Typical responsibilities include: * Provide remote and in\-person technical support to client users * Troubleshoot Windows desktop and laptop issues * Support Microsoft 365, Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, and SharePoint * Manage common Microsoft 365 and Entra ID user administration tasks * Create, modify, and disable user accounts and permissions * Troubleshoot printers, scanners, peripherals, and office technology * Diagnose basic LAN, Wi\-Fi, VPN, DNS, DHCP, and connectivity problems * Troubleshoot software installation and application issues * Support workstation deployments, replacements, and user migrations * Assist with Active Directory and Group Policy troubleshooting * Perform basic network and firewall troubleshooting * Work with endpoint management, RMM, security, and backup platforms * Respond to endpoint and security alerts and escalate when appropriate * Document troubleshooting, resolutions, and client environments * Maintain accurate and timely ticket updates * Escalate complex issues while providing the next technician with useful troubleshooting information * Participate in client onboarding and technology deployment projects What We're Looking For This is **not a zero\-experience help desk position**. We're looking for someone who understands the fundamentals and can independently work through common IT problems. A strong candidate should have experience with several of the following: * Windows 10/11 administration and troubleshooting * Microsoft 365 administration * Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD * Active Directory * Outlook and Exchange Online troubleshooting * Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, and SharePoint * Basic TCP/IP networking * DNS and DHCP * VPN troubleshooting * Wi\-Fi and wired network troubleshooting * Printer and peripheral troubleshooting * Endpoint security and antivirus/EDR concepts * Remote support tools * Ticketing systems * Basic PowerShell or command\-line troubleshooting Experience working for an **MSP or internal IT help desk** is a major plus. **Our Approach to Troubleshooting** We're looking for someone who doesn't immediately escalate when the easy answer doesn't work. You don't need to know everything. Nobody does. You'll have access to experienced technicians and engineers for escalation, but the goal is to **solve problems—not simply route tickets.** What Makes Someone Successful Here Technical skills matter, but so does how you work with people. We're looking for someone who: * Communicates clearly with both technical and non\-technical users * Has strong troubleshooting and critical\-thinking skills * Takes ownership of issues from beginning to resolution * Is comfortable asking questions when necessary * Can manage multiple tickets and competing priorities * Documents their work * Shows up reliably and works well with a team * Enjoys learning new technologies * Doesn't need a step\-by\-step KB article for every problem * Understands that excellent IT support is also excellent customer service Preferred Certifications Certifications aren't required, but relevant certifications are a plus, including: * CompTIA A\+ * CompTIA Network\+ * CompTIA Security\+ * Microsoft 365 certifications * Microsoft Azure / Entra certifications * Other relevant IT or cybersecurity certifications Equivalent hands\-on experience is absolutely considered. Why Stratus Services? Working at an MSP gives you exposure to technology at a pace that's difficult to find in a traditional internal IT position. You'll work across different organizations, environments, technologies, and problems while learning directly from experienced IT and cybersecurity professionals. For someone who wants to grow from help desk support into **Tier 2 support, systems administration, networking, cloud, or cybersecurity**, this role provides an opportunity to build that foundation quickly. Work Location **Anchorage, Alaska** This is a **full\-time, in\-office position**. Applicants should live in the Anchorage area or be willing to relocate. Apply If you're technically curious, enjoy solving problems, and want to continue building your IT career, we'd like to hear from you. Please submit your resume along with a brief introduction describing your IT experience and the types of technical problems you're comfortable troubleshooting. **Stratus Services is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $20\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * Have you ever worked for a Managed Service Provider before? Location: * Anchorage, AK 99507 (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Cloud Data Engineer
jobs.description: Shared Services ##### **Superior Automotive** Fayetteville, AR ##### **About the Role** Location: Northwest Arkansas (on\-site) Employment type: Full\-time, exempt We are a multi\-vertical, family\-owned enterprise operating since 1987, with holdings across automotive retail, heavy equipment, beverage distribution, and aviation. As we continue to acquire and integrate new businesses, we are investing in a modern, governed data platform on Google Cloud to unlock business intelligence, operational analytics, and AI\-driven decision\-making across every vertical. The Cloud Engineer will be a foundational hire to build our next generation data platform powering reporting, analytics, and AI use cases across our enterprise. This role will work to implement a medallion\-architecture data warehouse using tools like Google BigQuery and Dataplex, ingesting data from operational systems including CDK Global DMS, ERP platforms, IoT and telematics sources, and SaaS applications across our verticals. This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who wants to shape a greenfield platform, not maintain a legacy one. What you will do Build the data platform Design and implement a medallion\-architecture (bronze / silver / gold) data warehouse in BigQuery, including ingestion, transformation, and curated semantic layers. Stand up and operate Dataplex for data cataloging, lineage, data quality, and unified governance across business domains. Build batch and streaming ingestion pipelines from sources such as CDK Global DMS, ERPs, telematics, IoT devices, SaaS APIs, and on\-premise databases using tools such as Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Datastream, Cloud Composer (Airflow), and Cloud Run. Develop transformation pipelines using SQL, dbt, or Dataform, with strong attention to modularity, testing, and version control. Operate and harden Implement infrastructure\-as\-code for all cloud resources, with CI/CD pipelines for data and infrastructure deployments. Build clear separations for Development / Testing / Production data environments. Establish monitoring, alerting, cost controls, and FinOps practices for BigQuery slot usage, storage tiers, and pipeline reliability. Implement security controls including IAM, VPC Service Controls, CMEK, column\- and row\-level security, and integration with our identity provider. Partner on DLP, masking, and data classification strategies that support both analytics and AI use cases (including governed sandbox environments). Enable the business Partner with vertical leaders, finance, and operations to translate business questions into well\-modeled, performant data products. Build curated marts and semantic models that power BI tools (Looker, Power BI, Tableau, or similar) and self\-service analytics. Prepare the platform to serve downstream AI and ML use cases, including feature stores, vector search (BigQuery, Vertex AI), and Retrieval\-Augmented Generation patterns. Document architectures, data contracts, and runbooks What you bring Required experience 5\+ years of professional data engineering or cloud engineering experience, with at least 2\+ years on Google Cloud. Demonstrated production experience with BigQuery Strong SQL skills Solid understanding of data warehousing concepts including medallion / lakehouse architectures, dimensional modeling, slowly changing dimensions, and data contracts. Working knowledge of data security and governance concepts: IAM, encryption, PII handling, data classification, and audit logging. jobs.description: **Job Summary** **PURPOSE** **The Business Analyst conducts moderate\-to\-high complexity analysis of automated surveillance systems that detect potential violations of regulatory rules. This role is responsible for understanding, validating, enhancing, and supporting surveillance patterns across multiple asset classes and regulatory domains. The analyst serves as the bridge between regulatory requirements and the technical implementation of surveillance logic, ensuring patterns produce accurate, complete, and defensible results. The analyst is expected to actively leverage generative AI tools to accelerate analysis,** **documentation, and automation — serving as the domain expert who directs AI capabilities while ensuring regulatory accuracy and completeness of all outputs.** **CORE FUNCTIONS** **Surveillance Pattern Analysis \& Knowledge Management** **Reverse\-engineers surveillance pattern source code to build comprehensive knowledge documentation covering data pipelines, business rules, exception logic, and output schemas** **Maintains a knowledge base of surveillance patterns across multiple regulatory domains** **Performs requirements\-vs\-code gap analysis to identify discrepancies between documented business requirements and implemented logic, flagging risks to surveillance coverage** **UAT \& Release Validation** **Validates new surveillance pattern releases by comparing production vs. UAT outputs, analyzing exception counts, volumes, and firm\-level impacts** **Builds local testing environments to execute query scripts against sample data, enabling independent verification of pattern logic before production deployment** **Designs multi\-scenario test cases covering edge cases to Support** **Writes complex queries to support analyst investigations into surveillance exceptions** **Performs firm\-level statistical analysis and produces reports for management review** **Maintains reference data sets used by downstream surveillance patterns** **Assesses data incident impacts by cross\-referencing affected data sources against the surveillance pattern dependency map** **Process Automation \& Tooling** **Develops automation tools for ticket management, release documentation, and workflow optimization** **Builds local testing frameworks that replicate production environments for rapid pattern testing and iteration** **Creates data visualization and comparison reports with interactive views, summary statistics, and color\-coded differentials** **Generative AI Integration \& Prompt Engineering** **Leverages AI coding assistants as a force multiplier — directing AI agents to reverse\-engineer source code, build knowledge documentation, generate test frameworks, and produce data comparison reports** **Designs structured AI workflows including pattern study pipelines, workflow assistants, and automated documentation generation** **Maintains a curated AI project workspace with standing instructions, conventions, and context files that enable consistent, high\-quality AI\-assisted output** **Coordinates multi\-step analytical tasks through AI — from reading source code and drafting requirements, to generating test harnesses and producing comparison reports — reducing turnaround from days to hours** **Evaluates and validates AI\-generated outputs for regulatory accuracy before use in production workflows** **Project Management Support** **Manages work across project tracking boards, tracking enhancement tickets, bug fixes, and new pattern development** **Drafts and updates Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) for surveillance pattern enhancements** **Coordinates release activities including documentation, QC, and UAT sign\-off tracking\\** **OTHER RESPONSIBILITIES** **Participates on special projects as assigned. Serves as a mentor for less experienced analysts.** **Keeps management updated on notable trends in industry practices, regulatory changes, and emerging technology capabilities (including AI tooling).** **Champions adoption of AI\-assisted workflows within the team.** **QUALIFICATIONS** **Required:** **Bachelor's degree and 5\+ years of experience in financial regulatory technology, surveillance systems, or capital markets data analysis** **Proficiency in SQL for large\-scale data analysis on distributed platforms** **Proficiency in at least one scripting/programming language for data analysis, automation, and tool development** **Experience reading and interpreting complex data processing pipelines and business logic in source code** **Strong analytical skills with the ability to independently investigate data discrepancies and validate system outputs** **Excellent documentation skills — ability to translate complex technical implementations into clear business\-facing knowledge documents** **Advanced proficiency in spreadsheet tools for business and operational analysis** **Preferred:** **Major in Business Administration, Finance, Computer Science, or related field; advanced degree preferred** **Knowledge of SEC/FINRA regulatory rules and reporting requirements** **Experience with distributed query engines and big data platforms** **Experience with project management and documentation tools and their APIs** **Familiarity with surveillance pattern architectures (exception generation, scoring, aggregation, reconciliation)** **Experience with source code management and release branch workflows** **Experience leveraging generative AI tools (LLMs, AI coding assistants) to accelerate data analysis, code comprehension, documentation, and automation workflows** **Ability to design effective AI prompts and structured project contexts that produce reliable, domain\-accurate outputs in a regulated environment** Join us as a Financial Business Analyst where your expertise will empower strategic decision\-making, optimize financial performance, and contribute significantly to our organization’s success! Pay: $50\.00 \- $60\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Work Location: In person

**Required Skills \& Qualifications** * **Core Technical Experience:** 5\+ years of professional engineering experience in DevOps or Cloud Engineering, with a track record of identifying automation gaps, recommending IaC improvements, and troubleshooting multi\-environment or hybrid setups. * **Cloud Infrastructure \& IaC:** Proficiency in modern IaC and orchestration tools (e.g., Terraform, Kubernetes, Ansible, CloudFormation), with experience managing core cloud network topologies. * **CI/CD \& Automation Proficiency:** Solid experience with CI/CD systems (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD) and strong scripting skills (e.g., Python, Bash) for automating routine tasks and reducing manual toil. * **Observability \& Reliability:** Hands\-on experience with industry\-standard observability tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Prometheus, Datadog, Grafana) to develop proactive alerts, metrics, and dashboards. * **Security \& Compliance:** Experience managing secrets and access using infrastructure requirements, risks, and opportunities, with a proven ability to partner effectively with developers and IT to support secure, reliable delivery pipelines. *Education* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, systems engineering, or a related technical field. **Benefits** At Tenet3, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support both your personal and professional well\-being: * **Generous Paid Time Off**: Including PTO, sick days, and floating holidays to help you recharge. * **Comprehensive Health Coverage**: 100% paid medical, vision, and dental insurance for you and your family. * **HSA Contribution:** Company contribution to help offset costs of the health insurance deductibles. * **Retirement Plan**: 401(k) with company match * **Educational Support**: Reimbursement for higher education, conferences, and self\-study programs to support your continued learning. * **Disability \& Life Insurance**: Short\-term and long\-term disability, along with life insurance. * **Flexible Work Hours**: Flex time to accommodate your work\-life balance. jobs.title: Automation and Controls Engineer [DF]
jobs.description: **Make a meaningful difference:** At Thatcher Chemical facilities across the nation, our manufacturing teams create the essential chemistries, processes, and solutions that support clean water, safe environments, reliable infrastructure, and critical industries. From production and quality to logistics and distribution, your precision, dedication, and commitment to continuous improvement help transform raw materials and innovative science into real\-world solutions. Your purpose\-driven work plays a vital role in protecting public health, supporting communities, and shaping a safer, more sustainable future. Thatcher Company is seeking a skilled Controls Engineer to join our engineering team in Salt Lake City, UT. This role would lead and support automation and process control initiatives within our manufacturing operations. It would also include managing capital projects, improving system performance and reliability, and ensuring compliance with safety and regulatory standards. What You Will Do * Lead and manage control system–related capital projects, including new installations, expansions, and major upgrades. * Develop project scopes, budgets, schedules, and technical requirements for control system initiatives. * Coordinate with engineering, operations, IT, vendors, and contractors to ensure successful project execution. * Review and approve control system designs, programming standards, and hardware selections. * Oversee commissioning, testing, and startup activities to ensure systems meet performance, safety, and compliance requirements. * Monitor and improve manufacturing process control and safety system performance. * Identify and implement opportunities to improve process monitoring, system efficiency, reliability, and standardization. * Recommend technological upgrades and automation best practices. * Diagnose and resolve control system and instrumentation issues to minimize downtime. * Perform control system modifications, upgrades, and optimizations. * Support installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of control and instrumentation systems. * Provide technical guidance to maintenance and operations teams. * Support preventive and predictive maintenance programs. * Maintain control system documentation, including drawings, I/O lists, and software backups. * Ensure compliance with applicable codes, standards, and company safety procedures, including electrical safety and lockout/tagout (LOTO). * Support audits and regulatory inspections as needed. Basic Qualifications * Bachelor’s degree in engineering (i.e: Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical, etc.) with 5\+ years of experience in a chemical or manufacturing facility. * Experience in PLC systems, including understanding PLC ladder logic. * Travel \=\< 15% * Ability to lift up to 50 pounds. * Ability to frequently stand, walk, lift, carry, push, pull, reach, handle, bend, twist, climb and balance. What Will Put You Ahead * Experience in industry control systems. * Experience creating P\&IDs and Electrical Schematics. * Experience with managing controls projects. * Familiarity with Delta V, Schneider (Modicon) PLCs, Codesys based IEC 61131\-3 PLCs, Automation Direct Productivity PLCs, Beijer X2 HMIs. * Experience with networking, industrial Ethernet, and basic cybersecurity concepts. * Experience in the chemical industry with manufacturing processes, or experience in refining and major petrochemical operations. Why Thatcher is right for you * 100% company\-funded Profit\-Sharing Plan (up to 25% of salary annually) * 401(k) with traditional and Roth contribution options * Comprehensive benefits: medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short\- and long\-term disability, HSA/FSA, * 3\+ weeks of PTO, and paid holidays * Education reimbursement and ongoing professional development. The pay for the successful candidate will depend on various factors (e.g., qualifications, education, prior experience). jobs.title: Research Product Manager AP Intelligence
jobs.description: The Associated Press is an independent global news organization dedicated to factual reporting. Founded in 1846, AP today remains the most trusted source of fast, accurate, unbiased news in all formats and the essential provider of the technology and services vital to the news business. More than half the world's population sees AP journalism every day. **About AP Intelligence** The Associated Press is an independent global news organization dedicated to factual, accurate and nonpartisan reporting. AP Intelligence is building a new intelligence layer on top of AP’s global reporting—transforming verified journalism into structured facts, events, entities, relationships and signals that machines and people can use in real time. By combining AP’s firsthand reporting, editorial standards, historical depth and global reach with modern data and AI infrastructure, AP Intelligence creates machine\-readable intelligence that can be integrated into models, applications and decision systems. We are expanding the product team responsible for determining what intelligence can be derived from AP reporting, how we know it is useful and reliable, and which capabilities should become scalable products. **The Role** We are seeking an intellectually curious, highly analytical Research Product Manager to lead research and product definition for emerging AP Intelligence capabilities. This is a 0 1 individual contributor role. Much of the work begins before there is a roadmap—and sometimes before the precise product problem is fully understood. You will turn broad questions into structured hypotheses, research plans and experiments; investigate them using data, customer conversations and lightweight prototypes; and translate what you learn into clear product decisions and requirements. Here, “research” means structured product investigation: framing unanswered questions, working directly with data and product outputs, testing hypotheses, evaluating results and learning from customers. This is not a traditional feature\-delivery PM role. You will help discover the problems, define the products and establish the frameworks that allow engineering teams to build them. The role does not have direct reports at the outset, but offers significant ownership and visibility. As AP Intelligence grows, its scope may expand based on business needs and the individual’s strengths and interests, including deeper product leadership, domain ownership or people leadership. **What** **You’ll** **Do** *Research, Prototype \& Evaluate* * Lead research into ambiguous product questions across event intelligence, structured news data, knowledge graphs, real\-time information and AI systems. * Turn questions such as “What makes an event important?” or “How should we measure whether a signal is reliable and useful?” into hypotheses, experiments and evaluation frameworks. * Work hands\-on with AP datasets and product outputs, using tools such as SQL, Python, notebooks, LLMs and lightweight prototypes to test ideas. * Design benchmarks and evaluation methods for dimensions such as accuracy, timeliness, confidence, relevance and usefulness. * Identify patterns that can become scalable schemas, taxonomies, scoring systems and product capabilities. *Define Products \& Influence the Roadmap* * Translate research into clear product concepts, requirements and recommendations engineering teams can build. * Define how concepts such as event importance, impact, velocity, provenance and confidence become useful AP Intelligence capabilities. * Partner with engineering and applied AI teams to identify failure modes, improve product quality and move promising ideas from prototype to production. * Use evidence to recommend which ideas should advance, change or stop and to inform AP Intelligence priorities. *Learn With Customers \& Lead Across Disciplines* * Work directly with prospective customers and design partners to understand workflows, test emerging concepts and determine where AP Intelligence creates meaningful value. * Assess not only whether a capability is technically possible, but whether customers will integrate it, rely on it and pay for it. * Partner closely with journalists, engineers, AI teams, commercial teams and senior leaders. * Synthesize editorial, technical, customer and commercial perspectives into clear decisions and communicate complex ideas to technical and nontechnical audiences. **Who You Are** We expect strong candidates to bring many, but not necessarily all, of the following: * 6\+ years of relevant professional experience, including significant experience in product management, data products, AI/ML products, applied research, search/information systems or another highly analytical product environment. We care more about demonstrated 0 1 product ownership and judgment than a conventional career path. * A strong track record of taking ambiguous problems and independently turning them into structured questions, experiments and product recommendations. * Exceptional analytical and conceptual thinking, with an ability to find patterns in complex information and develop clear points of view from incomplete evidence. * Strong technical and data fluency. You do not need to be a production engineer, but should be comfortable exploring datasets, interrogating outputs and building lightweight analyses or prototypes. * Familiarity with structured or semi\-structured data and areas such as APIs, taxonomies, ontologies, knowledge graphs, search, retrieval or related information systems. * Working knowledge of modern AI systems and concepts, including LLMs, RAG, embeddings, information retrieval, structured outputs and model evaluation. * Strong product and customer judgment, including the ability to distinguish an interesting research problem from a capability customers will use and value. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills and comfort working across engineering, AI, journalism, commercial teams and senior leadership. Experience with AI/ML products, knowledge graphs, search/retrieval, real\-time or event\-driven data, intelligence platforms, AI evaluation, financial/risk/geopolitical information products, or early\-stage 0 1 environments is especially relevant, but not required. **What Success Looks Like** In your first year, you will have: * Turned important unanswered AP Intelligence questions into rigorous product investigations and clear recommendations. * Established benchmarks and evaluation frameworks for emerging capabilities. * Helped define and validate new event, signal and intelligence capabilities from research through product definition. * Influenced the AP Intelligence roadmap through evidence from data, customers and experimentation. **Why This Role** AP Intelligence sits at an unusual intersection of journalism, data infrastructure, artificial intelligence and real\-world decision\-making. AP has spent nearly two centuries building a global system for determining what happened, verifying it and communicating it accurately. AP Intelligence is exploring what becomes possible when that same reporting is structured for machines. For someone who enjoys ambiguous problems, data, emerging technology and building new products, this is an opportunity to help define a new category of product for AP. **Location, Salary \& Benefits** This role may be based in New York, NY or remotely within the United States. The anticipated salary range is **$140,000–$185,000****,** based on a candidate’s skills, qualifications and location. The Associated Press offers comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental and vision coverage; retirement benefits; company\-paid life insurance; paid vacation and sick days; paid parental leave; and mental well\-being resources. AP seeks to build an inclusive organization grounded in respect for differences. We support all aspects of diversity and provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, status as a veteran, or other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Photonics Systems Engineer II

Backed by a dedicated workforce of more than 3,000 employees worldwide, Thorlabs contributes to cutting\-edge research and real\-world innovation. Whether you're early in your career or bringing years of experience, you’ll find opportunities to grow, take ownership, and make meaningful contributions from day one. We know every employee brings unique talents and perspectives that fuel our success, and we seek driven individuals who are excited to make an impact in a fun, fast\-moving culture. The position will have a wide range of functions from research and development to product management and release to production, specifically the development of scientific tools. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Summary** The Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) is a hands\-on software engineer who works inside a client bank's environment to build, deploy, and customize an AI workflow automation platform for corporate actions and asset servicing. You will write production code, integrate market data and messaging feeds, and work side by side with the bank's engineers and operations teams. The right person pairs strong engineering execution with real working knowledge of how corporate actions are processed in the middle and back office. **Responsibilities** * Build and deploy: Write production\-grade code, configure data extraction schemas, and author custom business logic to deploy containerized services into live client environments. * Feed and API integration: Build, test, and maintain data pipelines that ingest and parse high\-volume market data and event feeds (Bloomberg, LSEG/Refinitiv, DTCC) through REST APIs and message queues. * Corporate actions workflows: Build and optimize automated event management workflows that handle lifecycle rules for mandatory and voluntary corporate actions, from announcement through election and payment. * Debugging and triage: Own technical triage during deployment, including infrastructure mismatches, code defects, slow queries, and data integrity issues. * Prototyping: Quickly build proofs of concept for middle and back office edge cases specific to the bank's architecture. * Client partnership: Work directly with the bank's engineers and operations staff, explain technical decisions clearly, and transfer knowledge so client teams can build and maintain workflows themselves. **Required** * 5\+ years of professional software development or technical implementation, with a track record of shipping code to production. * Strong backend coding skills in Python, Java, or C\#, and working proficiency with SQL. * Hands\-on experience with corporate actions or asset servicing technology at a bank, custodian, asset manager, or vendor, including how dividends, splits, mergers, and voluntary events are processed. * Experience integrating data feeds or APIs in a production financial environment. * Comfortable working onsite in a client\-facing role with engineers and operations stakeholders. **Preferred** * SWIFT corporate actions messaging: ISO 15022 (MT564, MT565, MT566\) and ISO 20022\. * Streaming and messaging tools such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or IBM MQ. * Containers and cloud: Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS, Azure, or GCP, plus CI/CD pipelines. * Experience integrating with mainframe or legacy core systems (DB2, batch processing, MQ). * Exposure to AI agents, LLM\-based tooling, or workflow automation platforms. Pay: $700\.00 \- $750\.00 per day Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Vice President of Product
jobs.description: Vice President of Product **Company:** Trumid **Location:** Remote – United States **Employment Type:** Full\-Time **Industry:** Financial Technology / Capital Markets / Fixed Income About Trumid Trumid is a financial technology company transforming the fixed income trading experience through innovative electronic trading solutions, intelligent automation, market data, and intuitive product design. Founded in 2014 by fixed income market experts, Trumid has grown into one of the leading electronic trading platforms in the U.S. The company serves a broad network of buy\-side and sell\-side institutions, including asset managers, banks, credit hedge funds, and alternative liquidity providers. Trumid's integrated platform supports multiple credit trading workflows and protocols, including RFQ, Portfolio Trading, Attributed Trading, and Swarms, alongside advanced pricing, data, analytics, and automated execution capabilities. By combining deep market expertise with agile technology and client\-focused product development, Trumid is building a more efficient, connected, and technology\-driven future for institutional fixed income trading. Position Overview Trumid is seeking an experienced and strategic **Vice President of Product** to help lead the continued development and expansion of our fixed income trading platform. The Vice President of Product will play a key leadership role in defining product strategy, identifying market opportunities, translating client needs into scalable solutions, and delivering products that improve the institutional trading experience. This individual will work closely with Product, Technology, Engineering, Data, Sales, Client Strategy, Operations, Compliance, and Executive Leadership to develop and execute the product roadmap. The ideal candidate combines deep product leadership experience with a strong understanding of financial markets, institutional trading, fintech, or capital markets technology. Key Responsibilities * Develop and execute product strategy aligned with Trumid's long\-term business objectives and growth priorities. * Own and evolve product roadmaps across key areas of the Trumid trading ecosystem. * Identify opportunities for new trading workflows, products, analytics, automation capabilities, and platform enhancements. * Translate institutional client needs and market developments into clear product requirements and strategic priorities. * Partner closely with Engineering and Technology teams throughout product design, development, testing, launch, and optimization. * Collaborate with traders, sales teams, institutional clients, and market participants to understand workflows, pain points, and emerging market requirements. * Drive innovation across electronic fixed income trading, execution workflows, pricing intelligence, market data, and trading automation. * Evaluate opportunities involving artificial intelligence, machine learning, automation, and data\-driven trading solutions. * Develop business cases and product strategies for new capabilities, markets, client segments, and strategic initiatives. * Establish product KPIs and use quantitative and qualitative data to evaluate adoption, engagement, performance, and client value. * Lead product discovery, prioritization, requirements definition, and go\-to\-market planning. * Partner with Sales and Client Strategy teams to support product adoption and strengthen relationships with institutional clients. * Work closely with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Operations teams to ensure products meet applicable regulatory and operational requirements. * Monitor developments in fixed income market structure, electronic trading, competitor platforms, and financial technology. * Present product strategy, performance, priorities, and recommendations to senior and executive leadership. * Mentor and develop product managers while helping build a high\-performing, client\-focused product organization. * Promote a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Qualifications * 15\+ years of experience in product management, financial technology, capital markets, electronic trading, financial services, or a related field. * 5\+ years of product leadership or senior management experience strongly preferred. * Demonstrated experience developing and launching sophisticated technology products or financial platforms. * Strong understanding of institutional financial markets and electronic trading environments. * Experience working with trading platforms, capital markets technology, market data, analytics, or financial infrastructure strongly preferred. * Proven ability to develop product strategy and translate strategic objectives into executable roadmaps. * Experience leading cross\-functional initiatives involving Product, Engineering, Technology, Sales, Operations, and Compliance. * Strong analytical skills and ability to use market, client, and product data to guide decision\-making. * Excellent understanding of product development methodologies and technology\-driven product organizations. * Strong commercial judgment with the ability to balance client requirements, market opportunities, technical considerations, and business objectives. * Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and executive communication skills. * Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and lead complex initiatives without relying solely on direct authority. * Ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced, highly collaborative, and evolving financial technology environment. * Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field required. * MBA or other relevant advanced degree preferred. Preferred Experience Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly desirable: * Fixed Income and Credit Markets * Corporate Bond Trading * Electronic Trading Platforms * Institutional Trading Workflows * Capital Markets Technology * Request\-for\-Quote (RFQ) Trading * Portfolio Trading * Algorithmic or Automated Trading * Market Data and Analytics * Pricing and Execution Technology * Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning * Buy\-Side or Sell\-Side Trading Technology * Financial Market Infrastructure Leadership Profile The successful candidate will be a product\-focused leader who understands how technology, market structure, data, and user experience come together to create differentiated financial products. This individual should be comfortable engaging directly with sophisticated institutional clients while also working closely with engineers, product managers, traders, sales professionals, and senior executives. We are looking for someone who can combine strategic thinking with hands\-on execution and who is motivated by solving complex problems within financial markets. Work Environment This is a **full\-time remote position within the United States**. jobs.title: Senior Boiler Operator, Engineering and Maintenance
jobs.description: California, US residents . **The job details are as follows:** Who We Are We are the first publicly\-traded biotech or pharmaceutical company to take the form of a public benefit corporation. Our public benefit purpose is to provide a brighter future for patients through the development of novel pharmaceutical therapies; and technologies that expand the availability of transplantable organs. United Therapeutics (Nasdaq: UTHR) seeks to travel down the corridors of indifference to develop treatments for rare, deadly diseases. We were founded in 1996 by a family seeking a cure for their daughter’s pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH). Today, we have six FDA\-approved therapies that treat PAH, pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease (PH\-ILD) and neuroblastoma, a rare pediatric cancer. Our near\-term pipeline seeks to develop additional therapies for PAH and pulmonary fibrosis (PF). The cure for end\-stage life\-threatening diseases like PAH, PH\-ILD, PF, and many others is an organ transplant, but only a small percentage of donated organs are available to address the vast need. For this reason, we are working to create manufactured organs to address the shortage of kidneys, hearts, lungs, and livers available for transplant. We believe an unlimited supply of tolerable, transplantable organs will eliminate the transplant waiting list and cure end\-stage organ diseases for which transplant is not currently an option. Who You Are As a Senior Boiler Operator, Engineering \& Maintenance, you’ll be the technical expert responsible for some of the most critical systems supporting the production of life\-changing therapies. From boilers, chillers, steam systems, and wastewater treatment equipment to the utilities that keep a cGMP facility operating around the clock, your expertise will help ensure safe, compliant, and uninterrupted operations. In this role, you’ll combine hands\-on troubleshooting, preventive maintenance, and system optimization with the leadership needed to mentor technicians, guide contractors, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. This opportunity is ideal for a technically skilled facilities professional who enjoys solving complex problems, taking ownership of critical infrastructure, and making a measurable impact every day. The Senior Boiler Operator, Engineering and Maintenance will act as the equipment subject matter expert (SME) and is primarily responsible for timely completion of preventive maintenance, technically advanced troubleshooting, and highly effective repairs of boilers, waste water treatment systems, chillers, and steam systems. jobs.title: HPC User Support Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** The University of Notre Dame is more than a workplace; it is a vibrant, mission\-driven community where every employee is valued and supported. Rooted in a tradition of excellence and inspired by our Catholic character, Notre Dame is committed to fostering an environment of care that nurtures the whole person—mind, body, and spirit. Here, you will find a deep sense of belonging, a culture that prioritizes well\-being, and the opportunity to grow your career while being a force for good in the world. Whether contributing to world\-class research, shaping the student experience, or supporting the University’s mission in other ways, you will be part of a dedicated team working to make a meaningful impact on campus and beyond. At Notre Dame, your work matters, and so do you! **Job Description** The Center for Research Computing (CRC) at the University of Notre Dame is seeking an HPC User Support Engineer to support researchers in effectively leveraging large\-scale computing and storage infrastructure. This position serves as a technical resource for undergraduate, graduate, faculty, and other computational researchers, helping them navigate complex high\-performance computing (HPC) environments, accelerated GPU clusters, and emerging AI/ML workflows to maximize the performance and efficiency of their research. The HPC User Support Engineer will bring expertise across Linux environments, programming and scripting languages, job scheduling, scientific applications, optimized compilers, mathematical libraries and algorithms, and distributed and parallel file systems. The role requires a combination of strong technical skills, problem\-solving ability, and excellent communication skills to address highly technical user needs and translate complex concepts for researchers with varying levels of computational experience. Working under the direction of the Center for Research Computing, this position may directly administer and support HPC systems or coordinate with colleagues across departments, colleges, and peer institutions to develop and maintain a world\-class research computing environment. Key Responsibilities * Provide technical support to users of high\-performance computing resources through email, virtual meetings, and in\-person consultations. Assess access issues, troubleshoot complex job workflows, investigate system problems, and resolve local and global application issues. * Analyze user challenges and identify opportunities to improve system documentation. Develop new documentation and update existing resources to provide clear guidance for common issues, workflows, and solutions. * Assist researchers with configuring, debugging, and scaling artificial intelligence, machine learning, and deep learning workflows across accelerated cluster infrastructure. * Lead and teach weekly HPC orientation and training sessions for undergraduate and graduate users, including researchers from both technical and non\-technical backgrounds. * Participate in workshops and other educational programs, which may occasionally require half\-day or full\-day sessions. Maintain and enhance training materials and contribute to developing new approaches to educating and supporting HPC users. * Work directly with researchers to debug, profile, and optimize scientific software and computational workflows, helping users improve the efficiency and performance of their applications on HPC resources. * Monitor and assess system usage to identify opportunities for improved performance, efficiency, and resource utilization. Collaborate with users to understand computational challenges and recommend appropriate solutions. * Support other HPC staff with system performance initiatives, emerging technologies, current tools and practices, and ongoing user education. * Coordinate with department, college, and external colleagues when specialized expertise or additional resources are needed to resolve technical challenges or advance HPC capabilities. * Communicate technical issues, recommendations, project updates, and progress effectively to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Stay current with developments in high\-performance computing, scientific software, programming frameworks, system architectures, and research computing practices. * Participate in occasional non\-standard work hours when necessary to support critical systems, maintenance activities, or research computing needs. * Perform other related duties as assigned. * This position is structured as a hybrid role requiring a minimum of 3 days per week on\-site to support in\-person consultations, lab visits, and classroom instruction. Regular campus business hours apply, with occasional flexible evening or weekend hours required for planned system maintenance, critical cluster support, or scheduled training sessions. **Qualifications** * Master’s degree in a STEM field with 1\+ years of experience in HPC or scientific computing support; Or * Bachelor’s degree in a STEM field with 3–5\+ years of relevant technical experience (with at least 1 year directly supporting HPC/scientific workflows); Or * An equivalent combination of education, relevant certifications, and experience. Preferred Qualifications * Experience supporting researchers in an academic, research, industry, or supercomputing environment. * Advanced knowledge of one or more HPC areas, including Linux, programming and scripting, parallel programming (MPI), job schedulers, scientific applications, numerical methods, debugging, profiling, optimization, or distributed file systems. * Experience supporting modern machine learning frameworks, data science toolsets, and interactive computing environments within an HPC or cluster environment. * Ability to quickly learn and independently develop expertise in new technologies and tools. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills. **Additional Information** *The University of Notre Dame seeks to attract, develop, and retain the highest quality faculty, staff and administration. The University is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national or ethnic origin, sex, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or age in employment. Moreover, Notre Dame prohibits discrimination against veterans or disabled qualified individuals, and complies with 41 CFR 60\-741\.5(a) and 41 CFR 60\-300\.5(a). We strongly encourage applications from candidates attracted to a university with a Catholic identity.*

jobs.title: Assoc Director - Responsible AI
jobs.description: ### **When you join Verizon** You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. Join the \#VTeamLife. **What you'll be doing…** As the Associate Director of Responsible AI, you will lead Verizon’s enterprise\-wide efforts to ensure our artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies are developed, deployed, and scaled safely, ethically, and equitably. Sitting at the intersection of technology, law, and business, you will serve as the central authority on AI risk and governance as Verizon continues to integrate advanced AI across our global 5G network and customer experiences. * Defining, scaling, and managing Verizon’s enterprise\-wide Responsible AI (RAI) framework to align with global standards like the NIST AI RMF. * Co\-chairing the AI Governance Council, facilitating strategic reviews of high\-impact AI use cases, and establishing clear "go/no\-go" criteria for model deployment. * Designing and implementing AI auditing processes focused on bias mitigation, algorithmic fairness, transparency, and explainability. * Partnering with Legal, Privacy, and Public Policy teams to navigate the rapidly evolving AI regulatory landscape (e.g., EU AI Act, FTC guidelines) and ensure strict compliance. * Leading cross\-functional AI "red\-teaming" and stress\-testing initiatives to identify vulnerabilities and edge\-case failures in production models. * Collaborating with ML engineers and product managers to embed RAI checkpoints directly into the CI/CD pipeline and ML lifecycle (MLOps). * Developing comprehensive training programs to upskill Verizon’s workforce on AI ethics, data privacy, and responsible development practices. **What we're looking for…** You are a strategic leader who seamlessly bridges the gap between complex technical algorithms and enterprise risk. You have a deep passion for technology ethics and possess the unique ability to translate abstract principles—like fairness and privacy—into measurable engineering metrics and operational workflows. With exceptional stakeholder management skills, you are just as comfortable discussing prompt injection risks with data scientists as you are presenting governance strategies to C\-suite executives. **You'll need to have:** * Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience. * Eight or more years of relevant work experience in technology policy, data governance, legal, risk management, or data science. * Three or more years of direct leadership experience in AI Governance, Responsible AI, Tech Ethics, or AI/ML Risk Management at an enterprise scale. * Deep understanding of machine learning lifecycles, generative AI technologies, and the specific ethical risks associated with Large Language Models (LLMs). * Demonstrated experience translating global AI and data regulations (e.g., NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act, GDPR, CCPA) into enterprise compliance strategies. **Even better if you have one or more of the following:** * A Master’s degree, JD, or PhD in Law, Public Policy, Computer Science, Data Ethics, Human\-Computer Interaction, or a related field. * Experience operating within highly regulated industries such as Telecommunications, Financial Services, or Healthcare. * Active certifications in privacy or risk (e.g., CIPP/US, CIPT) or relevant AI ethics credentials. * A proven track record of representing your organization in industry consortiums, academic partnerships, or standard\-setting bodies focused on AI ethics and safety. ### **Where you’ll be working** In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the United States without current or future visa sponsorship.*** ***This is a full\-time onsite role based in Sunnyvale, CA; remote and hybrid options are not available.*** **Role Summary:** The Staff, Software Engineer plays a critical role in delivering scalable platform capabilities and driving the full software development lifecycle, including design, coding, testing, deployment, and maintenance. This position leads technical execution aligned with strategic roadmaps, applies cloud\-native architecture principles, and integrates AI/ML components to enhance automation and product innovation. The role involves mentoring engineers, influencing architectural decisions, and collaborating across teams to solve complex problems using data\-driven approaches. Commitment to engineering excellence, continuous improvement, and effective communication is essential to support business objectives and technical sustainability. **About the Team:** The Global Seller Support team delivers scalable platform capabilities and innovative technical solutions to empower sellers worldwide. This team develops AI\-powered platforms and intelligent automation that enhance Walmart Marketplace support experiences. Engineers address complex, large\-scale challenges using cloud\-native technologies, Generative AI, and modern software engineering practices. The team focuses on creating reliable, high\-impact products that support one of the world’s largest eCommerce ecosystems, driving continuous improvement and technical excellence to meet evolving business and customer needs. **What You'll Do:** * Define the technical strategy and architecture for large\-scale Marketplace Support platforms. * Lead the design and implementation of AI/LLM\-powered agentic workflows and intelligent automation. * Build resilient, scalable, and observable distributed systems handling millions of seller interactions. * Drive engineering excellence through architecture reviews, design standards, and technical mentorship. * Partner with Product, Data Science, and Operations to translate business problems into scalable platform capabilities. * Influence engineering roadmaps across multiple organizations and lead cross\-functional technical initiatives. * Champion platform reliability, performance, security, and operational excellence. * Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business needs into actionable technical requirements and measurable success metrics. * Maintain architectural documentation and ensure quality, reliability, and alignment with long\-term business goals. **What You'll Bring:** * 10\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with deep expertise in Java, Python, AI solutions, big data platforms, Azure Cosmos DB, and large\-scale rack system development. * Extensive experience in platform engineering leadership, delivering scalable, cloud\-native architectures and reusable tooling. * Proven ability to drive full software development lifecycle, including coding, testing, CI/CD deployment, and incident response. * Expertise in designing distributed systems optimized for real\-time data processing and AI/ML integration. * Strong technical judgment with a focus on architectural decision\-making and long\-term system evolution. * Proficiency in AI agents, model\-driven design, and cloud computing architecture. * Demonstrated leadership in mentoring engineers and fostering engineering excellence. * Effective collaboration and communication skills with cross\-functional teams. **Preferred Experience and Qualifications:** * E\-commerce domain experience strong preferred. **About Walmart Global Tech:** Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people\-led and tech\-empowered. We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail. jobs.title: Production Engineer
jobs.description: **Webull is a leading digital brokerage platform built on next generation global infrastructure. At Webull, we believe that everyone should have an equal opportunity to control their own financial future. Our vision has always been to empower individual investors with the tools and resources they need to succeed financially. This commitment remains at the heart of everything we do. From low\-fee trading and robust market data to advanced analytical tools, we are committed to providing a seamless, top\-tier trading experience.** **About The Role \& Team** As a Production Engineer at Webull, you will be at the heart of our mission to provide a seamless, top\-tier trading experience for millions of global investors. You will serve as the critical technical bridge between our global operations and engineering teams, ensuring the high availability and resilience of our 24/7 trading infrastructure. This is more than a support role; you will champion operational excellence by resolving complex production issues, automating manual workflows, and leveraging cutting\-edge technologies (including AI agents) to scale our next\-generation brokerage platform. **In This Role, You Will** * Ensure System Resilience: Proactively monitor Webull’s global Order Management Systems (OMS) and mission\-critical applications 24/7 to maintain 99\.99% system stability. * Strategic Problem Solving: Act as the primary technical liaison between Back\-Office Operations and Development teams; manage L1/L2 production incidents and spearhead root\-cause analysis (RCA) for L3 escalations. * Incident Management \& Orchestration: Partner with the Client Services team to track, prioritize, and resolve client\-facing incidents through the ticketing system, ensuring timely resolution and high satisfaction. * Operational Excellence: Streamline daily technical operations and provide expert support for complex database systems and middleware. * Drive Innovation through Automation: Design and build robust scripts, automation frameworks, or AI agents to eliminate repetitive tasks and enhance production efficiency. * Global Trading Support: Collaborate across time zones to support global trading sessions, adapting to irregular shifts (including early mornings, late nights, or weekends) as needed. **The Skills You Bring** * A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field. * 1\+ years of experience in IT production support, SRE, or systems engineering within high\-availability environments. * Hands\-on experience managing MySQL/NoSQL databases and middleware technologies such as Kafka and Redis. * Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, Java, or JavaScript) with a solid grasp of data structures and algorithms. * Strong understanding of Linux internals and container orchestration technologies like Kubernetes (K8s) and Docker. * A self\-starter mindset with the ability to maintain peak performance and clear\-headed decision\-making under high\-pressure, mission\-critical scenarios. * Willingness to work irregular hours to support a global market that never sleeps. **What Makes You Stand Out** * Previous experience in the broker\-dealer, electronic trading, or fintech industry. * Fluency in Mandarin and English to effectively collaborate with our global engineering hubs. * Familiarity with AI agents, LLM integration, or advanced automation for operational scaling. * Broad knowledge of AWS cloud infrastructure and best practices. * Exceptional ability to translate complex technical issues into clear insights for diverse stakeholders. **Why Webull?** Webull is more than a fintech company—we’re a global community of innovators, collaborators, and trailblazers. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, FL, Webull operates in 16 regions worldwide, serving over 20 million users. At Webull, your ideas matter, your voice is heard, and your work makes a real impact. Investing in our people is a top priority for us, which is why we have a comprehensive benefits package that includes: * **Comprehensive Health Coverage**: 100% paid medical and dental insurance for employees and dependents, vision insurance, and more! * **Financial Support**: 401(k) match, commuter benefits for NY positions, and short\-term disability coverage. * **Work\-Life Balance**: Generous time off that increases with tenure, paid parental leave, personal days, sick time, volunteer days and company holidays. * **Wellness \& Pet Care**: Fitness and wellness benefits, plus pet insurance for your furry friends. * **Investing in Your Future:** We provide tuition reimbursement to help you pursue relevant degrees, certifications, and training that align with your career goals. * **Dynamic Office Perks**: Catered breakfast (every Monday) \& lunches (every Friday), fully stocked kitchens, and monthly happy hours to connect and collaborate. This role is based in our St Pete Global HQ (200 Carillon Pkwy, FL), where in\-person collaboration fuels growth, mentorship, and innovation. At Webull, we’re committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation. The base salary range is $75,000\-90,000 annually, plus a discretionary bonus and full benefits. Final offers consider experience, location, and relevant qualifications. **EEOC Statement** Webull is an equal opportunity employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team where all backgrounds, perspectives, and talents are valued.

jobs.title: Technical Field Service Coordinator/Dispatcher
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Technical Field Service Coordinator / Dispatcher **Reports To**: Director of Corporate IT **Pay Status**: Exempt **Job Summary:** This position serves as a key communication point between customers, field technicians, management, and internal technical teams. The ideal candidate is comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment, managing multiple priorities, troubleshooting issues, and ensuring field technicians have the information and resources needed to complete service calls efficiently. **What Success Looks Like:** A successful **Technical Field Service Coordinator / Dispatcher** ensures that technicians have the **right information, resources, and schedule** needed to complete each job efficiently and successfully. This person will be comfortable communicating with highly technical field personnel while understanding the general nature of the work being performed. They will be able to identify scheduling requirements, coordinate the necessary resources, recognize when an issue requires escalation, and keep customers, technicians, and internal teams informed throughout the service process. The ideal candidate can effectively speak both **“technical” and “customer service.”** They serve as the critical link between the field technician and the customer, ensuring that expectations are clear, information is communicated accurately, and issues are followed through to resolution. WT Solutions will provide training and ongoing support to ensure team members are properly prepared to perform their responsibilities effectively. **Education:** · 2\+ years of college preferred (60\) credits · Technical college diploma in IT, or a combination of equivalent education and experience preferred · 1 year experience in a NOC environment **Qualification and Skill Requirements:** · Proven scheduling and dispatch experience · Exposed to some NOC support experience · Ability to work flexible shifts and adapt to changing work schedules · Familiarity with mobile tools and applications · Data networking, routing, and security terminologies, and concepts · Cellular data service and hardware experience · Knowledge of Microsoft operating systems · Ability to effectively communicate with customers, peers, and management levels · Strong organization and troubleshooting skills · Ability to develop and improve company documentation and procedures · Must have exceptional attention to detail · Strong organizational and time management skills, and ability to prioritize · Must be a self\-starter and driven · Excellent communication and interpersonal skills · Strong problem\-solving skills and analytical abilities · Ability to multitask · Excellent verbal and written communication · Ability to follow the instructions · Strong interpersonal and Leadership skills **Duties and Responsibilities:** **Primary Function – Field Service Scheduling \& Dispatch** · Schedule and dispatch field technicians for break/fix service calls, installations, upgrades, preventive maintenance, and IT projects. · Assign technicians to jobs based on technical skills, certifications, availability, geographic location, project requirements, and customer needs. · Confirm technician availability and communicate job details, customer expectations, access requirements, and onsite procedures. · Monitor technician schedules and job progress throughout the day, proactively addressing delays, cancellations, emergencies, and scheduling conflicts. · Coordinate urgent, priority, and same\-day service requests while minimizing disruptions to existing schedules. · Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date technician calendars, dispatch schedules, work orders, and scheduling systems. · Coordinate with customers, project managers, service managers, and field technicians to ensure jobs are properly scheduled and completed. · Adjust schedules as needed to maximize technician productivity, minimize travel time, and meet customer response and completion requirements. · Follow up on open, delayed, or incomplete work orders to ensure timely resolution and accurate status updates. · Maintain clear communication with technicians and internal teams regarding schedule changes, job priorities, and special customer or site requirements. **Secondary Function – Tier 1 Network NOC Support** · Create, update, and escalate trouble tickets based on established NOC procedures and escalation criteria. · Provide Tier 1 Network Operations Center (NOC) support for customers monitored network, security, communications, and IT systems. · Escalate issues requiring Tier 2/3 engineering support or onsite service while maintaining accurate documentation and communication. · Monitor network and system alerts and respond to alarms, outages, connectivity issues, and other
